eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S08 E04 Who Wants to Be a Godparent? Lily and Marshall test their friends to see who would be the best godparents.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S08 E05 The Autumn of Breakups As Ted and Victoria consider the future of their relationship, Ted asks Lily and Marshall for advice; Robin is concerned when she learns that Barney's new wingman is a dog.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S08 E06 Splitsville Barney takes matters into his own hands when Robin is hesitant to end things with Nick; Marshall and Lily desperately want some private time.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: The Golden Life
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E01 Golden Years in a Golden Place The women pick up where they left off; Sonja tries to revisit the past with Dorinda; Ramona introduces the ladies to Palm Beach's rules; Kelly looks for love; Luann's boyfriend gets an extra-warm welcome.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: The Golden Life
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E02 I Need a Mocktail Sonja's moment with Luann's boyfriend puts the longtime friends at odds; Kelly dives into Palm Beach dating, only to land in Sonja's crosshairs; Avery urges Ramona to play peacemaker as friendships start to fracture.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: The Golden Life
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E03 Where's The Stylist? Luann enters the final stretch of her cabaret tour, while Dorinda tries to find her footing in Palm Beach; Sonja and Kelly put their clash behind them; meanwhile, a spa day goes awry when Sonja brings up some unfinished business with Dorinda.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: The Golden Life
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E04 People Will Think We're Nuts After a tense night, Dorinda is determined to pull off the perfect Palm Beach hat luncheon for the ladies; but when Sonja arrives fashionably late, tensions flare and Dorinda's elegant afternoon quickly turns into a hat-astrophe.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: The Golden Life
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E05 Cesspool Sonja attempts to hit the reset button with the group and hopes to reconnect with Luann; Kelly and Dorinda question Avery's Miami trip itinerary, sending Ramona into a tailspin as tensions reach a fever pitch among the ladies.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: The Golden Life
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S01 E06 She Lost Her Sugar on Me After tensions flare at Ramona's Pink Party, the ladies head to Miami hoping to reconnect and restore peace.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S08 E13 Band or DJ Robin insists that Barney ask her dad for permission to marry her; Ted tries to bury his feelings by throwing himself into wedding planning.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S08 E14 Ring Up Barney asks Ted to keep dating Carly (Ashley Benson), a much younger woman, even though she and Ted have nothing in common.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S08 E15 P.S. I Love You Barney finds an episode of Robin's "Underneath the Tunes" as Robin Sparkles; Lily and Marshall fear that Ted's new girlfriend is a stalker.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S08 E16 Bad Crazy Ted is reluctant to break things off with his unstable girlfriend (Abby Elliot); Robin holds Marvin for the first time.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S08 E17 The Ashtray When the Captain (Kyle MacLachlan) calls Ted unexpectedly, the gang remembers their last awkward encounter.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S08 E18 Weekend at Barney's After Ted and Jeanette break up, Barney uses his infamous playbook to Ted find a new date; Lily tries to make a good impression at a gallery opening.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S08 E19 The Fortress Robin wants Barney to sell his bachelor pad, but Barney is hesitant and drives potential buyers away; Lily's job as the Captain's art consultant strains her relationship with Marshall.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S08 E20 The Time Travelers Future versions of Ted and Barney try to talk Ted into seeing Robots Versus Wrestlers; Marshall wants to have a dance-off with Robin.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S08 E21 Romeward Bound Lily worries Marshall will resent her if she accepts The Captain's offer to move to Rome for a year; Ted and Barney obsess over an attractive girl in a puffy coat.

electricnow.us.title: Leverage: Redemption - The Hurricane Job
electricnow.us.description: Stuck together during a massive hurricane, Eliot and Parker must stop a band of corrupt cops who have taken over a small hotel, and find what the cops are searching for.

electricnow.us.title: Leverage: Redemption - The Great Train Job
electricnow.us.description: When a hate group targets two farmers, the team digs deep into a corrupt green energy innovator and plans a traditional train heist.

electricnow.us.title: Leverage: Redemption - The Muddy Waters Job
electricnow.us.description: The team goes undercover on an oil rig to find dirt on a crooked CEO who is covering up oil spills.

electricnow.us.title: Leverage: Redemption - The Harry Wilson Job
electricnow.us.description: The team sneaks into R.I.Z. to stop them from destroying the electrical grid, but they need Harry's help.

electricnow.us.title: Leverage: Redemption - Redemption: The Debutante Job
electricnow.us.description: The team pulls Harry back into the fold to help a journalist investigating corruption.

electricnow.us.title: Leverage: Redemption - The One Man's Trash Job
electricnow.us.description: The crew finds out that a shady plastics exporter whose dumping threatens local waters is smuggling black market antiquities on his barges, and plots to relieve him of his ill-gotten gains.

electricnow.us.title: Leverage: Redemption - The Tournament Job
electricnow.us.description: The team has to infiltrate an e-sports tournament to stop a ruthless team owner from mentally and physically abusing his young players.

electricnow.us.title: Leverage: Redemption - The Date Night Job
electricnow.us.description: While staging a date-night experience for "Parker and Hardison" at a freeport facility, the team comes across another heist in progress and must stop it to save the life of a 13-year-old boy.

electricnow.us.title: Leverage: Redemption - A Walk in the Woods Job
electricnow.us.description: While investigating the mysterious death of Eliot's friend, the team infiltrates an infamous enclave of power to take down the corrupt head of a private security company.

electricnow.us.title: Leverage: Redemption - The Fractured Job
electricnow.us.description: Eliot returns to his hometown and discovers that the runoff from an oil fracking company is now poisoning the water; the crew plots to take down the powerful man behind it all.

electricnow.us.title: Leverage: Redemption - The Big Rig Job
electricnow.us.description: The team infiltrates a trucking company to stop a pair of siblings from stealing their father's company and forcing his employees into indentured servitude.

electricnow.us.title: Leverage: Redemption - The Turkish Prisoner Job
electricnow.us.description: The team uses the true story of a World War I P.O.W. escape to free an innocent man framed by a pair of dirty cops.

electricnow.us.title: Leverage: Redemption - The Pyramid Job
electricnow.us.description: Prompted by Arthur Wilde, the team takes on a husband and wife couple who run a multilevel marketing pyramid scheme that emotionally and financially preys on young mothers.

electricnow.us.title: Leverage: Redemption - The Work-Study Job
electricnow.us.description: After a college professor steals a discovery from his grad student, the Leverage team has to take him down while returning the credit and reputation to the young woman in the process.

electricnow.us.title: Leverage: Redemption - The Belly of the Beast Job
electricnow.us.description: The team reluctantly enlists the help of a naïve but ambitious assistant to take down a predatory music producer; told from the point of view of a regular person.

electricnow.us.title: Leverage: Redemption - The Museum Makeover Job
electricnow.us.description: When a Leverage International team's museum heist goes awry, the crew goes in to finish the job, ultimately realizing they've been lured into a trap by a treacherous old friend.

electricnow.us.title: Leverage: Redemption - The Crowning Achievement Job
electricnow.us.description: When a formidable enemy steals the Maharaja's crown and traps the crew in the museum, they must find a way out and the crown before they go down for the crime.

electricnow.us.title: Leverage: Redemption - The Weekend in Paris Job
electricnow.us.description: On the run from a busted heist in Paris, the team finds themselves taking shelter among oligarchs auctioning off their home nations' precious resources; they have to create a new con to take down the group's ringleader and save an activist.

electricnow.us.title: Leverage: Redemption - The Digital Frankenstein Job
electricnow.us.description: The team conducts a sting to snare a corrupt judge by using the perfect undercover briber, a completely virtual tech visionary generated by A.I.; they watch as their "Digital Frankenstein" quickly spins out of control.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blind Horizon
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Prom Night
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Long Walk Home
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A boy (Julian Dennison) and his foster father (Sam Neill) become the subjects of a manhunt after they get stranded in the New Zealand wilderness.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Cold Blood
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Straight A's
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: At the behest of his mother's ghost, an addict (Ryan Phillippe) returns to his Louisiana home, where he must confront an ex-lover (Anna Paquin) who is now married to his brother.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: I'm Charlie Walker
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Jack's Back
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Mysteria
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Aleister Bain (Robert Miano), a whiskey-soaked and washed-up Hollywood screenwriter, desperately struggles to finish a script.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Getaway
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

But Jordan, a gifted and cocky test pilot, may be the corps' only hope when a new enemy called Parallax threatens the universal balance of power.

As two clans descend on the scene of the young twins' birthday party, Greg must find a way through myriad misunderstandings to prove to Jack -- once and for all -- that he is worthy of being the next family patriarch.

hbozone.us.title: The Royal Tenenbaums

Virtually all memory of the brilliance of the young Tenenbaums was subsequently erased by two decades of betrayal, failure, and disaster, until the family experiences an unexpected reunion and gather under the same roof.

hbozone.us.title: Battle of the Sexes
hbozone.us.description: The 1973 tennis match between Billie Jean King and Bobby Riggs became the most watched televised sports event of all time. Trapped in the media glare, King and Riggs were on opposites sides of a binary argument, but off-court each was fighting more personal and complex battles. With her husband urging her to fight for equal pay, the private King was also struggling to come to terms with her own sexuality, while Riggs gambled his legacy and reputation in a bid to relive the glories of his past.

Ewing (Jason Robards), the aging owner of the neighboring ranch, to coerce her into selling. When oil companies begin pressuring both ranchers to allow drilling, Ella's position becomes even more perilous. Though Ella thinks she's scrappy enough to fight them on her own, her chances get better with the arrival of hunky war veteran Frank "Buck" Athearn (James Caan).

hdnetmovies.us.title: Sam Whiskey

A drop-dead-gorgeous woman (Angie Dickinson) wants to quietly give back the gold her husband had stolen, now that he's dead. She approaches Sam to retrieve the gold from the bottom of a river and smuggle it back into the mint. The widow's beauty, and the nice sum she promises him, leave Sam powerless to resist the preposterous proposal.

hdnetmovies.us.title: Breakheart Pass

Also on board are Utah's governor (Richard Crenna), his mistress (Jill Ireland), a marshal (Ben Johnson) and his prisoner, outlaw John Deakin (Charles Bronson). As the train passes through the mountains, soldiers go missing, telegraph lines are cut, and it's discovered that there is no epidemic. There's a conspiracy afoot, and it's up to Deakin, actually a federal agent, to expose it.

history.ca.description: When earning a paycheck meant risking life and limb; from dangling off skyscrapers without safety harnesses and riding runaway logs down raging rivers, to digging up corpses for cash and selling your own blood to scrape by, people once took unbelievable risks no paycheck could truly cover; whether racing pizzas across town at breakneck speed or pulling off death-defying Hollywood stunts, people once did whatever it took to earn a living.

history.ca.title: The Proof Is Out There - Area 51 Crash, Yeti Footprints, And Human PIN Cushion
history.ca.description: Did a mysterious crash near Area 51 involve a secret military aircraft or something even stranger? Could a famous photograph of giant footprints finally prove the existence of the legendary Yeti? How did one man survive having a sword driven through his body? And does a controversial map prove China reached the Americas before Columbus? Tony Harris and his team of experts dive into these claims to find the truth.

history.ca.description: Small-town farmer Orville Redenbacher has a lifelong dream of creating the perfect popcorn kernel, leading to the first significant development of popcorn in thousands of years, which he sells nationwide.

history.ca.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Harrowing Highways ᴺᵉʷ
history.ca.description: Remember when hitting the road promised freedom, adventure… and a few risky surprises? From marathon cross-country races that pushed drivers to the limit, to flaming roadside smudge pots that lined the way after dark, to endless stretches of highway that lulled motorists into dangerous trances, America's love affair with the open road was full of unexpected twists and turns; these are the engineering feats and automotive innovations that transformed the journey.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Church Dis-service

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Seedy Intentions

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - DNA Dragnet
hln.us.description: Forensic investigators try to stop a killer who is apparently responsible for two slayings in a community in South Carolina.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Smiley Face
hln.us.description: When DNA proves that a man who practically admits to a brutal attack is innocent, police wonder why he is willing to take the blame.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Dirty Laundry
hln.us.description: When a businessman is murdered, motives and suspects are plentiful. Was it simply a disgruntled employee or client? Or do some racy photos hold the clue to the crime?

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Drowning Sorrows
hln.us.description: A family break turns into a nightmare when the wife is found face-down in a lake; with no idea whether it was murder, an accident or suicide, police turn to a new forensic technique.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - As Fault
hln.us.description: When friends see a woman in the back of a car flailing her arms and screaming, they assume she is having fun, but when they later come upon a jacket and a pool of blood, they realize they witnessed an abduction in progress.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Family Ties
hln.us.description: An attack on a couple's home leaves the husband dead, the wife gravely injured and their son as a prime suspect; hundreds of miles away, a DNA sample may lead to the killer.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Trouble Brewing
hln.us.description: Detectives think they've solved a murder when they find the weapon and victim's blood in a man's flat, but the evidence may have been planted.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Holy Terror
hln.us.description: Detectives search for the bombers of two churches in Illinois, hoping that the materials used in the remnants of the handmade bombs will offer the clues to catch the culprits.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Needle in a Haystack
hln.us.description: There was no apparent reason for the young, healthy college student to be dead; but when the medical examiner found the tiniest of clues during the autopsy, investigators were able to unravel the mystery of betrayal and revenge.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Room With a View
hln.us.description: A woman is stabbed a hundred times and her body positioned in a suggestive manner. This could be a hate crime against women.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Dollars and Sense
hln.us.description: Police are able to create a composite sketch of a man burnt beyond recognition. But tracking the killer is more challenging.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Hair Line
hln.us.description: By cutting a strand of a murdered man's hair into sections, forensics reveal a record of his last six months alive, and find he was frequently ingesting huge amounts of arsenic.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - All That Glitters Is Gold
hln.us.description: A bullet-riddled car, a missing driver, and no witnesses, an ambush or a random attack; the clue was something so tiny, it was measured in millionths of a meter.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Deadly Rebellion
hln.us.description: Teenager is found half-naked with her throat slit; a single foreign hair found on her thumb may finger the killer.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Sign of the Crime
hln.us.description: Two women who lived in the same apartment complex were brutally murdered; the similarities of the crime scenes led police to believe they were dealing with a serial killer who hated women, and they had to find him before he struck again.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Covet Thy Neighbor
hln.us.description: Weeks after a student vanishes, the body of an unknown female is found in the ashes of a fire 700 miles away; an alert policeman realizes the crimes could be connected.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Writing on the Wall
hln.us.description: Investigators face a growing list of suspects after a beautiful flight attendant is brutally murdered in her own home.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Hundreds of Reasons
hln.us.description: The assistant manager of the restaurant had been stabbed to death; police knew why he'd been killed: $8,000 was missing from the safe. As to who was responsible, his family and friends couldn't even imagine who'd want to hurt him.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Cold Feet
hln.us.description: Florida authorities rely on DNA evidence to try to nail the killer of a woman who was abducted from her late-night job at a convenience store, raped and strangled.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Separation Anxiety
hln.us.description: A wildfire in a secluded parking lot leads police to discover a dreadful homicide, with the suspect's image caught by security cameras.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Office Visit
hln.us.description: After a prominent Arizona surgeon is found stabbed to death outside his office, investigators uncover an unlikely suspect with deep pockets and an even deeper hatred for the doctor.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Shoe-in for Murder
hln.us.description: Police don't have a basis for comparison to match shoe impressions, blood drops and DNA evidence from a murder scene.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Family Interrupted
hln.us.description: A masked gunman kills two members of a family and wounds two others after they interrupt his burglary at their upscale suburban home.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Palm Saturday
hln.us.description: A killer leaves equally incriminating evidence at the scene when he meticulously wipes away his fingerprint and shoe impressions.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Sunday School Ambush
hln.us.description: Investigators unravel a twisted tale of lust, greed and deception after a woman claims her husband was gunned down by intruders.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Penchant for Poison
hln.us.description: Three seemingly unrelated deaths proved to be serial murders; the killer had been careful, he used poison which had no taste or odour; fortunately for investigators, it also has a unique chemical signature.

indieplex.us.title: The Limey
indieplex.us.description: The Limey follows Wilson (Terence Stamp), a tough English ex-con who travels to Los Angeles to avenge his daughter's death. Upon arrival, Wilson goes to task battling Valentine (Peter Fonda) and an army of L.A.'s toughest criminals, hoping to find clues and piece together what happened. After surviving a near-death beating, getting thrown from a building and being chased down a dangerous mountain road, the Englishman decides to dole out some bodily harm of his own.

To the dismay of the government, Courbet approves a reality show that will become network television's first foray into snuff. In the first episode, contestants engage in a deadly game of Russian roulette for the chance at a multi-million-dollar cash prize.

indieplex.us.title: Surfer, Dude
indieplex.us.description: Steve Addington is a professional surfer and beach bum who lives to ride the waves. Content simply to live in the moment, he has a dilemma when his finances dry up and businessman Eddie Zarno offers to hire him for a virtual reality game. Since there are suddenly no good waves in the ocean, Addington must reconsider Zarno's offer and ponder his place in the world. Struggling with the choice, Addington seeks advice from his friends.

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. kdka.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
kdka.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

The crew members, known as yachties, live aboard the luxurious, privately owned vessels while making sure that their demanding clients' ever-changing needs are met. The yachties share a passion for a job that allows them to visit some of the world's most beautiful places. Each episode features a different group of passengers -- ranging from millionaires to hard-partying friends -- as they head out for a marine adventure. The crews live by the "work hard, play harder" motto that gives them access to exotic perks few people get to experience.

khou.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
khou.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

kolndt.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
kolndt.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

kpho.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. kyw.us.title: Let's Make a Deal ᴺᵉʷ
kyw.us.description: CBS adds to its daytime game-show lineup with an updated version of the classic TV show of the 1960s, filmed in Los Angeles. Hosted by comic/singer/actor Wayne Brady, contestants -- often dressed in a wide variety of original costumes -- will still compete for money and prizes by striking wacky deals. Jonathan Mangum is the show's announcer, and Monty Hall, arguably the best-known host of the earlier version of the show, is listed among the new show's creative consultants. The program won a Daytime Creative Arts Emmy Award for Outstanding Original Song in 2014 for "30,000 Reasons to Love Me," composed by Cat Gray and performed by Wayne Brady. (Game show) - 2009-10-05

kyw.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
kyw.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

magnolianetwork.us.title: Salvage Dawgs - Trinity Lutheran Church

magnolianetwork.us.title: Salvage Dawgs - Esther Ludwig Mansion

magnolianetwork.us.title: Barnwood Builders - The Johnny Jett Special
magnolianetwork.us.description: The Barnwood Builders honor machinist, artist and craftsman Johnny Jett; a highlight of Johnny's most unforgettable moments as well as previously unaired footage featuring West Virginia's favorite Renaissance man.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Revamping the Cook's Beach Camp

magnolianetwork.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Golden Years Family Camp

magnolianetwork.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Lobster Shack Scramble

magnolianetwork.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - A Cabin for the Whole Family

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Fresh Pontiac Power in the T-37!

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Dragoneer Forever!

motortrend.us.description: The 1991 Land Rover Defender is known for ruggedness and simplicity; Mod Mafia does a reboot of a tired, old Defender with modern performance, power and custom luxury; Wide Open Garage takes an old-school Bronco monster truck into overdrive.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal's Loud and Lifted - Hummer H1 King
motortrend.us.description: Social media star Liver King not only wants Mod Mafia to beef up his prized 2001 H1 Hummer's performance, he wants to customize it for his primal lifestyle; the team at Wide Open Garage must build a custom off-road truck completely from scratch.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill - Stubby Bob Strikes Back!
motortrend.us.description: The guys retry road-tripping Stubby Bob to a dirt drag track in Arizona.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill - Off-Road Pacer Road Trip!
motortrend.us.description: Freiburger surprises David Chappelle with a road trip in an old project: Dirt Every Day's '76 Off-Road Pacer. Not much works in this lifted 4x4 AMC, but that doesn't stop the guys from ignoring problems, tempting fate and pressing on down the road.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill - Stripped Down at the Dragstrip
motortrend.us.description: Freiburger and Finnegan pick up a Hemi-powered pickup to cut up and strip down at the dragstrip at MotorTrend's Roadkill Nights powered by Dodge.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill - Mazdarati 2.0: Project Car Showdown!
motortrend.us.description: Freiburger and Finnegan complete the Mazdarati 2.0 and bring some of "Roadkill's" project cars back to life; they road trip to a multi-car drag-cross showdown.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - It Sounds Bitchin'. Let's Make It Look Bitchin'
motortrendfasttv.us.description: A 1968 Chevrolet Camaro has a new owner who wants to finish off the build with a new front valance, rear spoiler and fresh paint; a 1965 Ford Mustang with mechanical issues gets an upgrade.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - The Supernova
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Kindig-It Design finally finishes the 1967 Chevrolet Nova after 16 years of work; despite looking pretty stock on the outside, the vehicle boasts a unique power station underneath the hood.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - The One Where Nick Gets Arrested
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The guys set their sights on a major car show in Pleasanton, Calif., and work to get a Chevelle road ready for its owner.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - That's One Bitchin' Grocery Getter
motortrendfasttv.us.description: A repeat client and collaborator's new project for Kindig It is a 1927 Shadow Rod; a 2017 Bentley Bentayga receives some styling upgrades.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - I Blew Your Inheritance on a Bitchin' Ride
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Tad Leach is eager to have his dream car built by Kindig It Design; Dave goes big on the build of a rare 1958 Lincoln Continental; the upholstery shop updates the seats and headliner on a rare 1969 McLaren.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - A Lincoln Legend
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The Continental build continues; the vehicle receives a custom blue color, massive V12 engine, and the green light from a living legend; Dave wants a new car hauler and enlists RMD Garage to help.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Land of 10,000 Bitchin' Rides
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Kevin and Dave gear up for the Back to the 50s car show in St. Paul, Minn.; Dave runs a sweepstake to raise money for charity, awarding the 1929 roadster to one lucky contestant.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - If It Was Easy, Anyone Could Do It
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The metal masters take on a 1967 Chevelle with Great 8 pedigree and high expectations; Dave learns the hard way that builds do not always go according to plan.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - A Family Affair
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The entire Kindig family works hard to convert a '57 Corvette into a bitchin' ride as a retirement gift for Charity's father, but getting the kids motivated to help is easier said than done; a 1967 Malibu's AC is repaired.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - It's Getting Hot in Here
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The shop pulls out all the stops to take home the gold at the last car show of the season; the Fairlane and the Nomad receive extra attention; Dave and Kevin check out the best vehicles in Reno.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - The Future Is Now
motortrendfasttv.us.description: A '32 roadster is secretly purchased for a client's wife and shipped to Kindig It Design for mechanical upgrades and styling changes; Dave redesigns a 2004 Hummer.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - The Secret Client
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Dave is tasked with finding and transforming a 1967 Pontiac GTO for a secret client from South Africa; Dave buys back one of his first builds, a Volkswagen Karmann Ghia, but does not know what he will do with it when he gets it back on the road.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - GT...Ohhh Hell Yeah!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Final details on the 1967 Pontiac GTO include tanzanite blue paint, redline wheels and a custom interior; a Chevelle arrives for a small but poignant upgrade.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - We Build Bitchin Rides
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Dave and the team at Kindig It Design start a new year with a one-of-a-kind build they have never attempted before, a 1964 Ranchero; the car looks to have had a lot of work done, but what's underneath the metal sets the team back.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - 24 Karat Magic
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The Ranchero build is an epic achievement for Dave and the whole Kindig It Design team, but they hope the client sees it the same way; Dave seeks the perfect name for the perfect car.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - The Little Sister
motortrendfasttv.us.description: A Canadian father-daughter team arrives to add a new ride to their impressive collection; building the little sister to the '62 Safari Bus is something close to Dave's VW roots; fresh off the showroom floor, a 2017 Cadillac CTSV.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - A Caldera-What?
motortrendfasttv.us.description: An old build is back for new customizations, an interior revamp and a new name; with Kevin headed out of town, Dave tries to sneak a new and personal project through the doors.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - The Hummer of the Future
motortrendfasttv.us.description: A new client arrives and asks Dave to envision a future where the Hummer H2 continued to be produced and to build what he thinks that car might look like 20 years into the future; it's out with the old and in with the new, as Kevin leads the charge.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Fiberglass, Fiberglass and More Fiberglass
motortrendfasttv.us.description: One of Dave's all-time favorite designs is the Mercedes Gullwing, and a new client arrives with a kit version of the car; the car kit has many flaws, which the team needs to address while trying to get the car as close as they can to the original.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - The Snowball Episode
motortrendfasttv.us.description: A '41 Chevy that has bounced around numerous shops rolls in for a quick trunk lid fix, but things go south very quickly; as if the shop wasn't busy enough, they kick off a Road Tour and the garage turns into an ER for broken down cars.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Green for the Money
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Every inch of the Mercedes Gullwing has finally been addressed, and the car comes to an epic conclusion; questions and challenges remain, including which color will be just right and whether the doors will actually function.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Where's the Gold, Paulie?
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Dave and the team swap the chassis in a 1955 Nomad and upgrade its performance, which will give this car the edge it was missing.

movies.us.title: Mission: Impossible
movies.us.description: When U.S. government operative Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise) and his mentor, Jim Phelps (Jon Voight), go on a covert assignment that takes a disastrous turn, Jim is killed, and Ethan becomes the prime murder suspect. Now a fugitive, Hunt recruits brilliant hacker Luther Stickell (Ving Rhames) and maverick pilot Franz Krieger (Jean Reno) to help him sneak into a heavily guarded CIA building to retrieve a confidential computer file that will prove his innocence.

movies.us.title: Mission: Impossible 2
movies.us.description: Tom Cruise returns to his role as Ethan Hunt in the second installment of "Mission: Impossible." This time Ethan Hunt leads his IMF team on a mission to capture a deadly German virus before it is released by terrorists. His mission is made impossible due to the fact that he is not the only person after samples of the disease. He must also contest with a gang of international terrorists headed by a turned bad former IMF agent who has already managed to steal the cure.

movies.us.title: Mission: Impossible III
movies.us.description: Retired from active duty, and training recruits for the Impossible Mission Force, agent Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise) faces the toughest foe of his career: Owen Davian (Philip Seymour Hoffman), an international broker of arms and information, who is as cunning as he is ruthless. Davian emerges to threaten Hunt and all that he holds dear -- including the woman Hunt loves.

movies.us.title: Mission: Impossible -- Ghost Protocol
movies.us.description: Blamed for a terrorist attack on the Kremlin, Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise) and the entire IMF agency are disavowed by the U.S. government, while the president initiates the Ghost Protocol. Forced to go "off the grid" -- left without resources or backup -- Hunt must somehow clear the agency's name and prevent another attack. Complicating matters even more, Ethan must undertake the impossible mission with a group of fellow IMF fugitives whose actual motives are suspect.

movies.us.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
movies.us.description: Easily excitable Neal Page (Steve Martin) is somewhat of a control freak. Trying to get home to Chicago to spend Thanksgiving with his wife (Laila Robins) and kids, his flight is rerouted to a distant city in Kansas because of a freak snowstorm, and his sanity begins to fray. Worse yet, he is forced to bunk up with talkative Del Griffith (John Candy), whom he finds extremely annoying. Together they must overcome the insanity of holiday travel to reach their intended destination.

Wesley offers to help Lindsey get back on her feet and, though he's already engaged, romantic sparks begin to fly. Charlotte and Alice set out on a road trip across the country, hoping to gain perspective and save the situation from ruin.

moviesphere.us.title: The Single Moms Club

Now, Death is stalking this group of mistaken survivors -- and one by one they are dying as they were supposed to on the highway.

nick.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Mooned!; Hysterical History
nick.uk.description: SpongeBob wants to catch an ultra-rare jellyfish and enlists the help of former jellyfishing champion, Kevin; on a trip to the museum, SpongeBob and Patrick teach Sandy all about Bikini Bottom's fascinating, yet questionable, history.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - The Chosen Chipmunk; Double Dangus
nick.uk.description: Alvin sneaks into Simon's new virtual reality game and is transported to a world in need of a hero; the chipmunks discover Officer Dangus has a twin brother that's a bully and encourage Dangus to stand up to him.

nick.uk.title: The Creature Cases - The Unidentified Shiny Object; The Case of the Crying Monkey
nick.uk.description: Mysterious lights are messing up the dancing at the firefly prom; the duo follows the jungle sounds to locate a baby monkey.

nick.uk.title: The Marsupilamis - Runaway Hope / Bring me the head of Professor Lopez
nick.uk.description: Hope's in a runaway bouncy ball. A statue is broken, but by whom?

nick.uk.title: Gabby's Dollhouse - Carlita the Ice Cream Truck!
nick.uk.description: Carlita has transformed into an ice cream truck; before she can deliver sweet treats to all the Gabby Cats, she'll need ice cream, a menu and a song.

nick.uk.title: The Smurfs - The Thirteenth Dessert; Slithering Smurfs
nick.uk.description: In keeping with one of the Smurfs' traditions, Chef Smurf and Blossom need to find a thirteenth dessert for Christmas dinner. Bubble and Jokey are the worst babysitters. They have turned Baby Smurf into a snail.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - A Knight's Tail; Dreambomber
nick.uk.description: When Eleanor discovers there are no female knights, she hides in a suit of armour and enters a knight competition; Alvin is having the best dreams of his life, until Theodore subconsciously invades them.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - Simon the Superb; The Sub
nick.uk.description: When Alvin makes fun of Simon's magic act, Simon challenges him to a magic duel. Alvin reluctantly signs up to teach the after school music class, but finds his classmates treat him differently as a teacher.

nick.uk.title: Rock Paper Scissors - Sandpaper's Workout Program / The Secret
nick.uk.description: Rock is bad at keeping secrets, so when he learns one that will devastate Paper, he goes to great lengths to keep it from him. Sandpaper is disappointed the trio is playing video games all day, so she signs them up for her personal workout program.

nick.uk.title: Rock Paper Scissors - Paper: Renowned Researcher/Meatball
nick.uk.description: Paper pretends to be an expert on cavemen athletics because no one could've possibly studied it before - only to meet an expert. Lou's cat, Meatball, is very sick, and he asks the trio to save him, so they help turn Lou's cat into a vampire.

nick.uk.title: Wylde Pak - The Three Ravens; Left Holding the Bag
nick.uk.description: Ellie and the kids investigate cryptic Mrs. Withers, but when Jack goes missing in her creepy home, Ellie and Lil must save him; eager to become master criminals, Lil and Jack help Chuck with his dirty laundry, but are they ready for a life of crime?

nick.uk.title: Sonic Prime - Grim Tidings
nick.uk.description: With the Paradox Prism in his hands, Nine begins building the Grim into his own personal paradise, unless Sonic and Shadow can convince him otherwise.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - The Tree House; Saving Simon
nick.uk.description: While cleaning out their treehouse, the girls reminisce about how they saved the tree from being cut down; Alvin and Theodore think that Simon is going away to boarding school.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - Oh Brother Where Art Thou; The Wall
nick.uk.description: Alvin thinks he's losing his mind when Simon goes missing and no one else even remembers who Simon is. When the girls at school cast votes for the cutest chipmunk on the bathroom wall, Alvin worries about the results.

nick.uk.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business - Who's a Good Baby?
nick.uk.description: Baby love has never been higher, but a crash is coming, and the Boss Baby and his crew are determined to bring Bubbeezee down for good.

nick.uk.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business - Yellow 100
nick.uk.description: As the newly named CEO, the Boss Baby sets a goal for baby love to hit 100%, and everyone works overtime to please him.

nick.uk.title: Rock Paper Scissors - Sandpaper's Workout Program / The Secret
nick.uk.description: Rock is bad at keeping secrets, so when he learns one that will devastate Paper, he goes to great lengths to keep it from him. Sandpaper is disappointed the trio is playing video games all day, so she signs them up for her personal workout program.

nick.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show - This Old Coffee Pot
nick.uk.description: After Cecil's moustache springs a leak, he needs Patrick to do his chores around the house. Squidina uses this as an opportunity to produce a home renovation show.

nick.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show - Witless for the Prosecution
nick.uk.description: SpongeBob represents Patrick in Kid Court.

nick.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Potato Puff; There Will Be Grease!
nick.uk.description: Mrs. Puff's new substitute teacher gives SpongeBob a crash course in driving; Mr. Krabs and Plankton must work together after discovering a well of miracle-grease under their restaurants.

nick.uk.title: Wylde Pak - Best Summer Ever!
nick.uk.description: Jack has a farewell party; the family rushes to take Jack to the airport.

nick.uk.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - A Midsummer Night's Scheme
nick.uk.description: Captain Perfect's younger sister, Penny, is veering towards a life of supervillain. Keen to impress Captain Perfect, Max takes it upon himself to guide her onto a better path.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Despicable Me 2
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Now that Gru has forsaken a life of crime to raise Margo, Agnes and Edith, he's trying to figure out how to provide for his new family. As he struggles with his responsibilities as a father, the Anti-Villain League, an organization dedicated to fighting evil, comes calling. The AVL sends Gru on a mission to capture the perpetrator of a spectacular heist, for who would be better than the world's greatest ex-villain to capture the individual who seeks to usurp his power.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Despicable Me 3
nickelodeonwest.us.description: The mischievous Minions hope that Gru will return to a life of crime after the new boss of the Anti-Villain League fires him. Instead, Gru decides to remain retired and travel to Freedonia to meet his long-lost twin brother for the first time. The reunited siblings soon find themselves in an uneasy alliance to take down the elusive Balthazar Bratt, a former 1980s child star who seeks revenge against the world.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - SpongeBob's Road to Christmas
nickelodeonwest.us.description: SpongeBob and his pals journey to the North Pole to give Santa a present.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Goons on the Moon
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Sandy leads the scouts through space for scientific exploration, where SpongeBob finds life exists in the form of a Krabby Patty, Sandy studies the moon's gravitational effect on nuts, and Squidward goes to the dark side.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Patchy the Pirate Presents the SpongeBob SquarePants Christmas Special
nickelodeonwest.us.description: When Santa doesn't show up on Christmas morning, everyone in Bikini Bottom blames SpongeBob for getting their hopes up.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - It's a SpongeBob Christmas!
nickelodeonwest.us.description: SpongeBob inadvertently helps Plankton get all the citizens of Bikini Bottom on Santa's naughty list.

nickelodeonwest.us.description: Rachel has a bone to pick with her self-centered sister (Christina Applegate) on Thanksgiving; Monica protects her good wedding china; Joey forgets to join his TV cast mates for the Thanksgiving parade.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With the Late Thanksgiving
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Monica prepares a Thanksgiving feast for the gang, then becomes enraged when everyone shows up late; Phoebe convinces Rachel to enter Emma in a baby beauty contest.

nickelodeonwest.us.description: Rachel sees Ross' list comparing her pros and cons to Julie's (Lauren Tom).

nickelodeonwest.us.description: Emotions become the feast of the day when the gang plays a game of touch football on Thanksgiving; the turkey is left stewing when the losing team calls for a rematch.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With Chandler in a Box
nickelodeonwest.us.description: To atone for kissing Joey's girlfriend, Chandler agrees to stay inside a shipping crate during the Thanksgiving holiday.

nickelodeonwest.us.description: As the gang digests Monica's huge Thanksgiving meal, everyone reminisces about their worst Thanksgiving ever.

nickelodeonwest.us.description: Calvin's wealthy and impulsive brother Curtis makes a surprise visit, which creates chaos in the Butlers' lives; Dave and Gemma run into challenges while trying to declutter their home.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Sanitation Insanity; Bunny Hunt
nickelodeonwest.us.description: When Mr. Krabs gets in trouble for littering, he makes SpongeBob and Squidward clean up Bikini Bottom; a sea bunny ravages Squidward's garden, but SpongeBob thinks it's cute.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Rescue Thanksgiving; Pups Save a Windy Bay
nickelodeonwest.us.description: When the bouncy turkey from the Thanksgiving feast at City Hall flies away with Mayor Humdinger and his kittens, the pups must save the day; an extremely strong wind suddenly sweeps up all the surfers in the Adventure Bay Windsurfing Race.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Woodland Walrus; Pups Save a DJ in a Jam
nickelodeonwest.us.description: After stowing away on the Turbots' camping trip, Wally the walrus gets stuck in a mountain crevasse, and it's up to Everest and the PAW Patrol to rescue him; Mayor Humdinger challenges Rubble for the right to deejay a dance party.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Aqua Pups Save the Reef; Aqua Pups Stop a Giant Squid
nickelodeonwest.us.description: The Aqua Pups rescue Coral, Moby and McSquidly from a submarine before it crashes into a delicate reef; the Aqua Pups must save the Merpups' golden orb release when Moby lures a Giant Squid into Puplantis.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Rubble and Wild in a Yarn of a Tail; Skye and Rory Flip It; Marshall and Leo Save the Ferris Wheel Passengers; Everest and Shade Save a Mountain Goat
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Rubble and Wild team up to stop a giant runaway yarn ball rolling through town; Marshall and Leo must rescue some critters stuck on a Ferris wheel.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Water Walker; Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Windsurfer
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Mayor Humdinger swipes Francois' water-walking shoes and ends up trapped in a pit-like turtle nest; the pups spring into action when a nearby volcano erupts.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Pups vs. a Neon Humdinger; Pups Save a Royal Painting
nickelodeonwest.us.description: When Mayor Humdinger's giant neon sign of himself gets loose, the PAW Patrol must stop it from rolling through town.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Baby Space Rocks; Pups Save the Eddies and Emmys
nickelodeonwest.us.description: When a mysterious storm drops hailstones that hatch into Baby Space Rocks, the Pups must find a way to keep them safe; a 3D printer leads to trouble when Eddie and Emmy make 3D reproductions of themselves and play pranks.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Air Rescue: Pups Save a Hum-stronaut
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Captain Gordy and his space shuttle are blasting off from the Adventure Bay Airport with a satellite! But when Mayor Humdinger sneaks on board to snap a couple of selfies, the space shuttle blasts off with him still inside! Air Rescue pups save him.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Hobbies
nickjr.uk.description: Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is a hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Patchwork Quilt
nickjr.uk.description: Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Granny Sheep's Art Van
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Being Inspired
nickjr.uk.description: Granny Sheep is driving Vanessa, the art van along the road with Peppa, Suzy, Pedro, Mandy, Molly and Danny. They are taking her to the boat yard, for her first-ever outing.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Sibling School
nickjr.uk.description: While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School, and learn about what to expect when the baby arrives.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - New Baby
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa is so excited to meet her new baby brother or sister, but they are taking forever to arrive until suddenly Mummy Pig announces the baby is coming, now.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Baby Names
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa is given the very important task of suggesting names for the new baby. She thinks of all sorts of names, but they aren't quite right.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Holding the Baby
nickjr.uk.description: The nurse visits, and she decides that today's visit should be all about how to hold a baby. The nurse shows Peppa a special way for a small person to safely hold a baby.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Hearing Test
nickjr.uk.description: Dr Brown Bear suggests Peppa and George have their hearing checked. The audiologist discovers George has a moderate hearing loss and suggests George tries a hearing aid.

nickjr.uk.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - Dinner Party
nickjr.uk.description: Snooty King and Queen Marigold invite themselves round for dinner to King and Queen Thistle's castle to sample Nanny Plum's cooking. Nanny tries hard to cook special modern food.

nickjr.uk.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - The Ant Farm
nickjr.uk.description: Things are going missing all over the Little Kingdom - Holly has lost her wand and Ben has lost his horn! Soon they realise that ants are stealing their things.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Scooters
nickjr.uk.description: Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to school on their scooters. He decides it would be faster to ride back and he discovers riding scooters is such fun. He shows Mummy Pig how fun it is.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Move To Music
nickjr.uk.description: Madame Gazelle is getting Peppa and her playgroup friends to dance to all different styles of music.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - London
nickjr.uk.description: Madame Gazelle takes the whole class to London for the day and get a tour by The Queen herself.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Simple Science
nickjr.uk.description: While the playground is getting rebuilt, Daddy Pig teaches the children some simple science.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Indoor Adventure
nickjr.uk.description: A storm cancels Peppa and her family's adventure plans so they decide to take it inside. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and have a campfire in the attic.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Hot Dry Day
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa and George are playing in their pool. They help the garden animals cool down but when it rains, the animals are happy and so is Peppa. Rain makes muddy puddles for jumping in.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Folk Music Band
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa and George are in Granny and Grandpa Pig's Garden. Granny's friends are playing folk music! They play music for Grandpa Pig and then Grandpa Pig makes apple juice for everyone.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Calling Kylie
nickjr.uk.description: It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn it's not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the earth.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - House Rules
nickjr.uk.description: While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised there are extra rules she doesn't have in her own house like no shoes indoors and no eating peanuts.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Big Announcement
nickjr.uk.description: Today is a special day because Mummy and Daddy Pig have big news to tell Peppa and George. However, Peppa and George struggle to wait patiently, so resort to playing games.

nickjr.uk.title: Thomas & Friends - Farmer's Market On Wheels All Engines Go!
nickjr.uk.description: Farmer's Market On Wheels: Nia leads the gang in planning the annual Fall Farmer's Market but, when no one shows up, she has to adapt and find a new way for everyone to enjoy the event.

nickjr.uk.title: The Adventures of Paddington - Paddington's Beach Clean Up
nickjr.uk.description: Paddington has an important job to do in 'Paddington's Earth Day Mission', then in 'Paddington's Special Spring Harvest Celebration', everyone enjoys bringing their own celebration along.

nickjr.uk.title: The Adventures of Paddington - Paddington's Holiday Farewell
nickjr.uk.description: Who is Paddington's Special visitor that Jonathan and Judy have helped come from afar? // It's the last night of Hanukkah and Mr Gruber's Hanukkiah breaks before he can light the final candle.

nickjr.uk.title: The Adventures of Paddington - Paddington's Puffling Rescue
nickjr.uk.description: The Windsor Ruby is missing in 'Paddington's Adventure Club Cracks The Case!', then in 'Paddington And Aunt Lucy's Special Recipe', the Browns set up a takeaway, but it's hard work.

nickjr.uk.title: The Adventures of Paddington - Paddington goes under the Sea
nickjr.uk.description: A game between England and Peru causes 'Paddington's Football Dilemma', then in 'Paddington Has To Say Goodbye', it's time for Aunt Lucy to go home, but there's still one more adventure.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Movie Night
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night. But before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, and which popcorn to eat.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Art House Day
nickjr.uk.description: Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day. After a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds the perfect artwork.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Wildflower Wood
nickjr.uk.description: Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers. The children enjoy identifying Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even an orchid.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Sunny Day Games
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa and George are playing at their grandparent's garden on a very hot day but they don't have a paddling pool.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Magic Trick
nickjr.uk.description: Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party, and Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Jumping Stick
nickjr.uk.description: Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick and tries to show how to use it, but finds it difficult. Peppa and her friends struggle too. But there's always jumping in muddy puddles.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Racquet Games
nickjr.uk.description: Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere! So, the children play badminton instead and it's a lot easier.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Adventure Caravan
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure and the first stop is The Biggest Potato in the World. When it starts to get foggy, they park up before another busy day.

nickjr.uk.title: Paw Patrol - Pups Save a Sleepwalking Mayor
nickjr.uk.description: It's Cowboy Day at the Wingnuts Dude Ranch. Mayor Goodway tries to brave the hazards of the ranch all while sleepwalking.

nickjr.uk.title: Paw Patrol - Pups Save a Cuckoo Clock
nickjr.uk.description: Jake's family cuckoo clock is sliding down the mountainside with Chickaletta stuck inside! Ryder calls on Everest to help the pups save the day.

nickjr.uk.title: The Adventures of Paddington - Paddington's Puffling Rescue
nickjr.uk.description: The Windsor Ruby is missing in 'Paddington's Adventure Club Cracks The Case!', then in 'Paddington And Aunt Lucy's Special Recipe', the Browns set up a takeaway, but it's hard work.

nickjr.uk.title: The Adventures of Paddington - Paddington goes under the Sea
nickjr.uk.description: A game between England and Peru causes 'Paddington's Football Dilemma', then in 'Paddington Has To Say Goodbye', it's time for Aunt Lucy to go home, but there's still one more adventure.

nickjr.uk.title: The Adventures of Paddington - Paddington's Rocking Chair Repair
nickjr.uk.description: A gate is left open when 'Paddington Opens the City Farm', then in 'Paddington the Upcycler', Baaz teaches Jonathan and Paddington about upcycling, but can the pair create something.

nickjr.uk.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - The New Wand
nickjr.uk.description: Wandy gets a cold and is taken ill, Holly is given a replacement wand. This new wand can do lots of things that Wandy can't, and soon becomes the favourite.

nickjr.uk.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - Gaston Goes to the Vet
nickjr.uk.description: Ben Elf and his parents are going on holiday in the elf truck but Gaston the Ladybird has swallowed the car keys.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - School Project
nickjr.uk.description: It's school project time for Peppa and her friends which means they have to build castles and bring them into playgroup.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Wendy Wolf's Birthday
nickjr.uk.description: Wendy Wolf's birthday is here and she has invited Peppa and friends around for a party.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Miss Rabbit's Taxi
nickjr.uk.description: Miss Rabbit takes Peppa and the family to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house to drop off their shopping off, but that's not the last trip of the day for her.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Hippies
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's while Granny hosts a historical re-enactment of the 1960s with her friends.

nickjr.uk.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds A Cooking Store
nickjr.uk.description: There's help from a kitten when 'The Crew Fixes A Blocked Pipe', then in 'The Crew Builds A Construction Basketball Show', when a basketball team doesn't show up, the pups take their place.

nickjr.uk.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Splashy Bottom
nickjr.uk.description: The pups hunt at the Farm Fair in 'Pups Save the Farm Festival', while in 'Pups and the Bubble Bath Bay', Rocky dreams of a sudsy adventure.

nickjr.uk.title: Tim Rex in Space - Explorer
nickjr.uk.description: Tim explores Rumbleton to find somewhere he can have fun alone.

nickjr.uk.title: Tim Rex in Space - Don't Go, Grandma
nickjr.uk.description: Tim, Tommy and Tia do all they can to stop Grandma leaving, so they can spend more time with her.

nickjr.uk.title: Tim Rex in Space - Movie
nickjr.uk.description: Tim tries to make his own Captain DinoStar movie.

nickjr.uk.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines - Mail Truck Blaze
nickjr.uk.description: When mail deliveries are needed around the world, Mail Truck Blaze will swim seas, climb mountains, and venture to the Monster Dome - because mail trucks ALWAYS deliver.

nickjr.uk.title: Gabby's Dollhouse - Snow Cruise
nickjr.uk.description: The Gabby Cats go on a cruise to see Pete the Polar Bear's new rainbow igloo. Along the way, Mercat helps them learn about all kinds of fun things that water does.

nickjr.uk.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - The Elf Games
nickjr.uk.description: Ben is in training for the elf games, Holly wants to join in but the rules state there is absolutely no flying or magic allowed. Ben gives Holly a chance to join in without using magic.

nickjr.uk.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - Chickens Ride West
nickjr.uk.description: King Thistle wants a boiled egg for his breakfast, so the elves decide to deliver the King the chickens from the Elf Farm so he can have an egg whenever he likes.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr. Bull Digs Up The River
nickjr.uk.description: Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They see Mr. Bull, who's using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Party Bus
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa receives an invite to Candy Cat's birthday party - on a double decker bus.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Broken Party Bus
nickjr.uk.description: Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken bus. This is a job for Grampy Rabbit! Once fixed, Mummy Rabbit and Rebecca Rabbit arrive with a cake for Grampy Rabbit's birthday.

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr Cat's Cafe
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Cafe. Candy show Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.

Once in Galveston, however, their rivalry continues, as Thomas joins up with Elya Carlson (Anita Ekberg) and Jarrett with Maxine Richter (Ursula Andress). But Matson is still on the loose, and a scheming banker threatens both Thomas and Jarrett.

outlaw.us.title: Miracle in the Wilderness

outlaw.us.title: 3 Godfathers

Pursued across the desert by the indefatigable Sheriff Buck Sweet (Ward Bond), the trio lose their horses, suffer injuries, and come across a stranded woman (Mildred Natwick) who is dying while giving birth. Promising to carry the woman's newborn to safety, the repentant criminals struggle to reach the village of New Jerusalem.

outlaw.us.title: The Godchild

outlaw.us.title: Three Godfathers
outlaw.us.description: In a town called New Jerusalem, bandits Bob Sangster (Chester Morris), Doc Underwood (Lewis Stone) and Gus Barton (Walter Brennan) hold up a bank. After a gun battle with the townspeople, the three robbers retreat into the scorching desert. There, they happen upon an ill woman stranded with her child. As the mother dies, she begs the men to take care of her infant. The fugitives want to save the baby -- but to do so, they'll have to travel back to New Jerusalem, where they are wanted men.

outlaw.us.title: Charro!

outlaw.us.title: They Died With Their Boots On
outlaw.us.description: George Armstrong Custer (Errol Flynn) is a rebellious but ambitious soldier, eager to join the Civil War. During the war, Custer has numerous successes to his credit, even though he disobeys orders. After the war concludes, he marries Libby Bacon (Olivia de Havilland) and is assigned to the Dakota Territory. Custer negotiates honestly with the Sioux on land, but due to corruption from others, a battle with Sitting Bull's forces occurs at Little Big Horn.

rfdtv.us.title: Gaither Gospel Hour - Giving Thanks
rfdtv.us.description: The Homecoming family gather at a cozy log cabin in the hills of Tennessee to express their gratitude! Bill and Gloria Gaither host a heartwarming musical celebration packed with plenty of music, stories, and countless reminders of the goodness of God.

rfdtv.us.title: Gaither Gospel Hour - Count Your Blessings
rfdtv.us.description: The Homecoming family count their blessings in a soul-stirring musical feast, hosted by Bill and Gloria Gaither. They look back at God's faithfulness through music and discover that a spirit of gratitude is good for the soul and makes the world so much better.

rifftrax.us.title: RiffTrax: Beast Of The Yellow Night - RiffTrax: Beast Of The Yellow Night

rifftrax.us.title: RiffTrax: The Visitor - RiffTrax: The Visitor
rifftrax.us.description: A baffling mess, as incoherent as it is unintentionally funny. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from RiffTrax (formerly of Mystery Science Theater 3000).

rmtv.uk.title: Date Me Right Now
rmtv.uk.description: S1E1 - Will football-mad MGK who compares love interests to FIFA cards meet his match on Soho's streets? And will Kim be able to persuade Geona - who only dates oldest siblings - to open her heart? (S1, ep1)

rmtv.uk.description: S15E218 - Judge Judy Sheindlin, a former judge from New York, tackles actual, small claims cases with her no-nonsense attitude in which damages of no more than $5,000 can be awarded. (S15, ep218)
