sbsbrisbane.au.title: Dd India News Hour
sbsbrisbane.au.description: The most recent political, sports, entertainment and socio-economic updates across India and the world from New Delhi, in English.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Beautiful Game Changers - Sahily Carrero: More Than A Comeback
sbsbrisbane.au.description: After losing her right arm in a workplace accident, Sahily Carrero returned to football and now inspires others through her strength, skill and determination.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Destination Flavour Down Under Bitesize - Destination Flavour Down Under Bitesize Series 1 Ep 1
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Some of your favourite moments and recipes from Adam Liaw's culinary and cultural journey through Australia and New Zealand.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Paul O'grady For The Love Of Dogs - Episode 4
sbsbrisbane.au.description: The Battersea staff and dogs are going on an outing this week - across the Thames to visit the Chelsea Pensioners. Paul is charged with looking after one of Battersea's most popular dogs - a stubborn old Staffie called Marcel.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Paul O'grady For The Love Of Dogs - Episode 5
sbsbrisbane.au.description: This week the Battersea staff have to deal with a tiny Chihuahua with a big aggression problem. They try and help little Bobby over come his behavioural issues, but he's not easy to retrain. Little old Yorkie Dexter proves that you don't have to be young and beautiful for someone to fall in love and take you home, and Paul works his magic befriending an anxious Golden Retriever called Skye who comes to Battersea after escaping from a house fire.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: How I Got Here - Trinidad: That's The Love
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Alexandria and her father, Anthony, travel to Trinidad to reconnect with family, culture and the places that shaped his early life. As Anthony reflects on growing up near Port of Spain and moving to the United States as a child, father and daughter explore their shared heritage, uncover family stories and gain a deeper understanding of the experiences that helped define their family’s journey.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Susan Calman's Grand Day Out - Countryside Special
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Susan Calman and her campervan, Helen Mirren, celebrate the joys of the countryside in this special episode. Visiting Hopetoun House, she experiences life in a grand stately home, from historic traditions to caring for wildlife in the gardens. Along the way, Susan looks back on some of her favourite rural adventures, revisiting the people, places and moments that made them memorable.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: BBC News At Ten
sbsbrisbane.au.description: The latest national and international news stories from the BBC News team from London, UK, in English.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: France 24 International Sbs Midday
sbsbrisbane.au.description: International news and current affairs television from Paris, offering a French perspective on world events, in English.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: PBS Newshour
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Reviews and analysis of the day's news, presented by Amna Nawaz and Geoff Bennett for the Public Broadcasting Service (PBS) in the United States.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Scottish Islands With Ben Fogle - Isle Of Mist - Skye
sbsbrisbane.au.description: On the breath-taking Isle of Skye, Ben Fogle investigate how spiritual and religious power still survives in the face of so many visitors and sets off to discover sacred places.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Going Places With Ernie Dingo - Pajinka, Broome, Sunraysia
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Aaron takes a trip to the tip of mainland Australia, Ernie reconnects with an old friend in Broome, and Narelda gets a taste of the Sunraysia region with chef Stefano de Pieri.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw - Food Culture
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Jung Eun Chae from Chae restaurant and Ukrainian chef Ivegen Klopotenko are in the kitchen with Adam, cooking with fermented ingredients.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: The Supervet - Milo, Bramble And Digby
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Families travel from far and wide to seek Noel’s expertise, and injured French bulldog, Milo is no exception. Brindle Boxer, Bramble has a mystery mass eating away at his knee bone, presenting Noel with a dilemma. Cool cat Digby has severe hip dysplasia and is brought in by a familiar face to the practice.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Jeopardy! - Jeopardy Series 42 Ep 184
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Ken Jennings hosts Jeopardy! Where the answers are revealed, and the contestants must guess the appropriate questions.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Letters And Numbers - Letters And Numbers Series 5 Ep 95
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Two contestants pit their linguistic and numerical skills against each other and the clock in this entertaining quiz show. Join host Richard Morecroft along with maths whiz Lily Serna and wordsmith David Astle.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Luca's Key Ingredient - Panetone
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: It's Christmas time, and what better way to celebrate an Italian festive season than with the beloved panettone?

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: My Market Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: The Prahran Market is buzzing with activity and Wendy from Stir the Pot is joining Laura to create one of her delightful recipes, a clever Potato Tart.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Jamie At Home - Summer Salad
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: Jamie explains the history of pickling and preserving. If you have grown your own produce, you'll want to save it and keep it for as long as you can.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Hong Kong Gourmet With Justine Schofield
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: We love it when Mrs. Schofield joins Justine in the kitchen!

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw - Food Culture
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: Jung Eun Chae from Chae restaurant and Ukrainian chef Ivegen Klopotenko are in the kitchen with Adam, cooking with fermented ingredients.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy - Doughn't Go Bakin' My Heart
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: Mary's straightforward bread recipes are all you knead: biscuits, buns, thick focaccia pizza, and a classic loaf.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Fruits Of The Sea
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: Lidia loves to prepare simple recipes with the freshest of seafood. She creates halibut with saffron fregola, tuna chickpea salad, and shares a recipe moment with her grandson, Miles.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Cheese Slices - Artisan Cheese Of The USA
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: Will's cheese tour takes him across the United States to look at artisanal cheese in regions not normally associated with specialist cheese.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Legends Of The Fork - Old-School Eateries
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: Buddy hits up two old school eateries that are straight out of a time machine. Starting with Superdawg in Chicago, a 50s style drive-in that serves up a legendary hot dog based on generational recipes.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy - Bread And Pizza
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: Sophie explores the traditional taralli biscuits made of wine and olive oil, goes in search of the perfect pizza and makes her own in the outdoor pizza oven.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery - Nynashamn, Sweden

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Based on a true story, this biographical film tells the story of two brothers as they compete for the highest honour in horse racing, The Melbourne Cup (2002). Directed by Simon Wincer.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Tony Takitani
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: A reclusive illustrator meets the love of his life, who happens to be a shop-a-holic.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Last Cab to Darwin
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: When Rex, a Broken Hill cab driver, is told he doesn't have long to live, he sets out on an epic journey to Darwin in a bid to die on his own terms.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: A Private Function
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: In the summer of 1947, Britain prepares to commemorate the wedding of Princess Elizabeth and Prince Phillip.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Storm Boy
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Mike is a lonely boy living in a coastal wilderness with his reclusive father. In search of friendship, he encounters an Indigenous man, and the two form a bond in the care of three pelican chicks.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Eloise At The Plaza
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Eloise, a spirited six-year-old, causes playful chaos under the care of her Nanny Julie Andrews, trying to matchmake a lonely prince and secure an invite to a high-society event.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: What We Did On Our Holiday
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Doug and Abi are taking their three children on a trip to Scotland for a big family gathering. They are in the midst of a difficult divorce, and have asked the kids to keep it a secret from their extended family.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Dirty Dancing
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Spending the summer at a Catskills resort with her family, Frances \.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Sons
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: The idealistic prison officer Eva is faced with the dilemma of her life when a young man from her past gets transferred to the prison where she works.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: A Good Person
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Allison's life falls apart following her involvement in a fatal accident. She finds solace in an unexpected relationship with her would-be father-in-law. He becomes her ally in her journey to healing.

screamboxtv.us.title: Bloodsuckers and the Grimoire
screamboxtv.us.description: Oliver grew up believing his father died when he was a toddler. But as college ends and life threatens to pull him into the ordinary, a brutal truth emerges -- that his father has just died and left him a remote cabin full of secrets.

screamboxtv.us.title: St. Agatha
screamboxtv.us.description: Pregnant and on the run, young Mary seeks refuge in an isolated convent in small-town Georgia in the 1950s. When she discovers the community's dark secrets, Mary must find a way to save herself and her baby before she's trapped there forever.

screamboxtv.us.title: ThanksKilling
screamboxtv.us.description: A possessed turkey terrorizes five college students during Thanksgiving break.

screamboxtv.us.title: ThanksKilling 3
screamboxtv.us.description: Turkey carves his way through college students on Thanksgiving break.

screamboxtv.us.title: Galaxy of Terror
screamboxtv.us.description: Neurotic astronauts (Edward Albert, Erin Moran, Ray Walston) face a giant worm and other monsters on a distant planet.

screamboxtv.us.title: Forbidden World
screamboxtv.us.description: A space ranger (Jesse Vint) lands at a research station where a flesh-eating mutant is loose.

screamboxtv.us.title: Auntie Lee's Meat Pies
screamboxtv.us.description: A devil-worshiping woman sends out her four beautiful nieces to find young men, who are lured back to her place so they can be killed, ground up, and sold as meat pies.

screamboxtv.us.title: Howling III
screamboxtv.us.description: An Australian scientist (Barry Otto) finds marsupial werewolves, one of whom (Imogen Annesley) finds work in a horror movie.

screamboxtv.us.title: Bloody Pit of Horror
screamboxtv.us.description: An ex-actor (Mickey Hargitay) turns into the Crimson Executioner when models pose in his castle's torture chamber.

screenpix.us.title: Guns, Girls and Gangsters
screenpix.us.description: A Las Vegas singer (Mamie Van Doren) plans an armored-car robbery with her husband's (Lee Van Cleef) ex-cellmate (Gerald Mohr).

screenpix.us.title: War, Italian Style
screenpix.us.description: Two Marines (Fred Clark) fool a German general (Buster Keaton) with documents and disguises in World War II Italy.

screenpix.us.title: Romance and Cigarettes
screenpix.us.description: In this musical that features characters lip-synching to classic songs, Nick (James Gandolfini), a Queens, N.Y.-based ironworker, lives with his wife, Kitty (Susan Sarandon), and three daughters. When Nick meets a significantly younger woman, Tula (Kate Winslet), he starts an affair with her, much to the chagrin of his wife, and his life is thrown into upheaval. Kitty kicks Nick out of the house, and he is forced to make some difficult decisions.

screenpix.us.title: Billie
screenpix.us.description: Billie (Patty Duke) is a tomboy who loves sports. When the high school track coach (Charles Lane) sees her run, he asks her to join the school team. Her inclusion in the formerly all-male team causes quite a stir, especially with her father (Jim Backus). He is typically supportive of Billie, but now he worries that her shocking behavior will cost him his bid for mayor. Nervously, he starts setting Billie up with dates, unaware that she has a crush on her classmate, Mike (Warren Berlinger).

screenpix.us.title: The First Time
screenpix.us.description: Searching for a Canadian bordello leads three teenage boys to a British beauty who scares them.

screenpix.us.title: Cul-de-Sac
screenpix.us.description: When on-the-lam crook Richard (Lionel Stander) and his injured partner-in-crime, Albie (Jack MacGowran), seek shelter in a remote castle by the sea, they find themselves confronted by the owners -- George (Donald Pleasence), an eccentric and weak retiree, and his oversexed wife, Teresa (Françoise Dorléac). Richard seizes control of the castle, but, as the criminals are pulled further into the isolated world of the strange couple, a volatile test of wills ensues.

screenpix.us.title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
screenpix.us.description: While preparations are underway for the marriage of Athenian duke Theseus (Derek Godfrey) and Amazon queen Hippolyta (Barbara Jefford), fairy king Oberon (Ian Richardson) and his tricky jester, Puck (Ian Holm), make mischief with the indiscriminate use of a powerful love potion. Lysander (David Warner) and Demetrius (Michael Jayston) both fall for Helena (Diana Rigg), raising the jealousy of Hermia (Helen Mirren), whose father is pressuring her to marry Demetrius despite Lysander's love for her.

screenpix.us.title: The Caretakers
screenpix.us.description: Dr. MacLeod, a psychiatrist, has developed a new type of therapy for severely disturbed individuals at a mental institution. However, head nurse Lucretia Terry resists these changes, feeling that the only effective ways of dealing with patients are force and punishment. Even though MacLeod is rebuffed by many of the hospital staff, his methods show promise on some patients, including the frenzied Lorna Melford.

screenpix.us.title: Legend of the Lost
screenpix.us.description: Brit Paul Bonnard (Rossano Brazzi) enlists gruff American Joe January (John Wayne) to help him find a hidden treasure that is worth a fortune. Before long, they are joined by prostitute Dita (Sophia Loren), who is moved by Bonnard's earnestness, and the three embark on a journey through the wild in hopes of finding an ancient lost city. They finally stumble upon the riches, but, after Bonnard feuds with Dita, he angrily takes the jewels and supplies, and leaves his partners to die in the desert.

screenpixaction.us.title: Four Boys and a Gun
screenpixaction.us.description: Young toughs will all die in the electric chair unless they tell who killed a policeman during a holdup.

screenpixaction.us.title: Warriors of Virtue
screenpixaction.us.description: Lame in one leg, Ryan Jeffers has few friends in his high school and spends most of his time with Chinese restaurant chef Ming, who gives him the Book of Tao. When he is goaded by the football team into a dangerous ceremony, Ryan falls into a whirlpool and emerges in the magical land of Tao. His leg fully healed, he is led to Master Chung, whose heroic warriors battle against greedy Lord Komodo. Ryan joins their fight.

screenpixaction.us.title: Sir Gawain and the Green Knight
screenpixaction.us.description: Round Table knight Gawain (Murray Head) beheads the Green Knight (Nigel Green), who expects a return stroke.

screenpixaction.us.title: The Boy and the Pirates
screenpixaction.us.description: On the beach near his home, Jimmy (Charles Herbert) finds a bottle that contains a genie named Abu (Joseph Turkel), who magically transports him to the ship of the pirate Blackbeard (Murvyn Vye). Abu explains that the bottle must be returned to its original location in three days, or Jimmy will take the genie's place. The pair spend a few eventful days with Blackbeard, evading capture, accompanied by a girl (Susan Gordon) they rescue, but Jimmy begins to wonder if he'll ever get back home.

screenpixaction.us.title: Little Norse Prince Valiant
screenpixaction.us.description: A Norwegian prince fights evil with a rock man's sword of the sun.

screenpixaction.us.title: Jack the Giant Killer
screenpixaction.us.description: Desiring control of the kingdom, an evil wizard, Pendragon (Torin Thatcher), devises a cunning machination to usurp the throne. By abducting Princess Elaine (Judi Meredith) and forcing her to marry him, Pendragon will coerce the king (Dayton Lummis) into abdicating his power. When Pendragon sends a giant to kidnap Elaine, a simple farmer, Jack (Kerwin Mathews), witnesses the abduction, and bravely slays the beast. Undeterred, Pendragon has more power and creatures at his disposal.

screenpixaction.us.title: No Such Thing
screenpixaction.us.description: Disgusted with human evolution, a foul-mouthed monster kills anyone who crosses his path. When a news crew sent to investigate the monster disappears, a guileless young woman is dispatched to follow up on the story. She befriends the monster and becomes his only hope in ending his life of misery.

screenpixaction.us.title: Mystery of the 13th Guest
screenpixaction.us.description: A young woman opens her grandfather's will when she turns 21, and someone starts murdering the heirs.

screenpixaction.us.title: The Walking Target
screenpixaction.us.description: An ex-con finds unexpected romance with the widow of his former accomplice as he tries to collect his hidden loot.

screenpixaction.us.title: The Nun and the Sergeant
screenpixaction.us.description: A Marine (Robert Webber) leads misfits on a mission in Korea with a nun (Anna Sten) and Asian schoolgirls for company.

screenpixaction.us.title: The Young Racers
screenpixaction.us.description: Auto racing hotshot Joe Machin (William Campbell) lives in the fast lane, cultivating a reputation as a wild card and a womanizer. Machin's rowdy ways get him into trouble, however, when Stephen Children (Mark Damon), the rejected fiancé of one of the driver's many lovers, decides to get revenge. A former racer who is now a writer, Children joins Machin's pit crew in order to dig up the dirt on his romantic rival. However, there may be more to Machin than meets the eye.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Windprints
screenpixvoices.us.description: Young South African cameraman Anton van Heerden and aging British journalist Charles Rutherford team up to gather information about an apparent Namibian serial killer. In a country ruled by a minority white government, Nhadiep seems only to murder other blacks. His proximity to the strange and horrifying crimes causes Anton to contemplate his role as a privileged white man in a continent where millions of blacks are oppressed.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Gabriela
screenpixvoices.us.description: A rich Turkish bar owner (Sônia Braga) falls in love with his beautiful Brazilian cook (Marcello Mastroianni).

screenpixvoices.us.title: Go Fish
screenpixvoices.us.description: After leaving behind her girlfriend to attend college in Chicago, young lesbian Max West (Guinevere Turner) is introduced to Ely (V.S. Brodie), a slightly older woman with quirky habits. While Max and Ely quickly develop an attraction to each other, a poorly timed phone call from Max's long-distance girlfriend, Kate, brings things to an abrupt halt. Meanwhile, Max's roommate, Kia (T. Wendy McMillan), helps her girlfriend, Evy (Migdalia Melendez), cope with some tough times at home.

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Perez Family
screenpixvoices.us.description: In the midst of the Mariel boat lift -- a hurried exodus of refugees from Cuba going to America -- an immigration clerk accidentally presumes that dissident Juan Raul Perez (Alfred Molina) and Dorita Evita Perez (Marisa Tomei) are married. United by their last name and a mutual resolve to emigrate, Dorita and Juan agree to play along. But it gets complicated when the two begin falling for each other just as Juan reunites with his wife, Carmela (Anjelica Huston), whom he hasn't seen in decades.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Love Chronicles
screenpixvoices.us.description: A disc jockey and a therapist help callers on a radio program sort through their relationship issues.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Hurricane Streets
screenpixvoices.us.description: A stark portrait of kids living on the edge, "Hurricane Streets" focuses on one teenager's fight to change the circumstances of his life. Brendan Sexton III delivers a powerful performance in the central role of Marcus, a street-smart teen who dreams of the day that he can escape the city trap and live with his mother in the wide open spaces of New Mexico.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: More Dead Than Alive
screenpixwesterns.us.description: An outlaw responsible for many deaths, Cain is released from prison after years behind bars. Despite his earlier wicked ways, Cain has made a real effort to reform and just wants to be left in peace. Unfortunately, his reputation limits his employment options, and he's left with no choice except becoming a performer in a Wild West show. Working for promoter Dan Ruffalo, Cain attempts to lead a relatively quiet life, but other gunslingers are still out to get him.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - Promised Land
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A town full of former outlaws kidnaps Bat and expects him to work as their trusty banker.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - The Conspiracy
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bat finds himself involved in the Lincoln assassination conspiracy 15 years after the crime.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - The Hostage
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Murderer Sam Edwards has been sentenced to hang, but his brother, John, kidnaps Harris and takes him hostage to save Sam from the gallows.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - The Governor
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Hollister risks his life to rescue the governor, who has been kidnapped by a gang.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Wanda Nevada
screenpixwesterns.us.description: In the American Southwest of the 1950s, middle-aged vagabond Beaudray Demerille (Peter Fonda) survives as a cardsharp who moves from town to town. But his latest victory brings him unwanted spoils in the form of Wanda Nevada (Brooke Shields), a fiery 13-year-old. At first Beaudray does everything he can to ditch Wanda -- until the girl chances upon a treasure map. But Wanda and Beaudray aren't the only ones after the loot, and they must contend with a ruthless pair of crooks.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: A Dog's Best Friend
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Married ranchers (Bill Williams, Marcia Henderson) take in an ungrateful boy (Roger Mobley) who befriends a slain hermit's German shepherd.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Belle of the Yukon
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A con man who has tried to turn over a new leaf, Honest John Calhoun (Randolph Scott) is the owner and operator of a dance hall in the north of Canada. John has hoped to evade both the police and his past, but his history catches up with him when his ex-girlfriend, Belle De Valle (Gypsy Rose Lee), appears in his venue as a member of a dance troupe. As John and Belle reunite, fellow entertainer Lettie Candless (Dinah Shore) also becomes infatuated with the suave businessman.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Sam Whiskey
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Great gambler Sam Whiskey (Burt Reynolds) has got his hands on a heist job that's pretty outrageous, even by Wild West standards. A drop-dead-gorgeous woman (Angie Dickinson) wants to quietly give back the gold her husband had stolen, now that he's dead. She approaches Sam to retrieve the gold from the bottom of a river and smuggle it back into the mint. The widow's beauty, and the nice sum she promises him, leave Sam powerless to resist the preposterous proposal.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Another Man, Another Chance
screenpixwesterns.us.description: When Jeanne (Geneviève Bujold), a young woman, falls for a photographer named Francis (Francis Huster), he convinces her to leave war-torn France and move to America with him. After they have set up a photography shop and have a baby, Francis dies. A few years later, Jeanne meets David (James Caan), a solitary man who cannot forget the murder of his wife. Jeanne and David start a relationship, but she worries that his dangerous search for his wife's killers threatens their love.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Comanche
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Renegade Comanche leader Black Cloud (Henry Brandon) attacks a Mexican village and kidnaps the beautiful Margarita Alvarez (Linda Cristal). Fleeing to the United States, they come across a band of scalp hunters and are prevented from massacring them by the Comanche chief of the Antelope tribe, Quanah (Kent Smith). Despite the efforts of frontier scout Jim Read (Dana Andrews), turmoil erupts between the whites and the rebel Comanche, and Quanah and Read struggle to restore peace.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: War Paint
screenpixwesterns.us.description: With only nine days to deliver a peace treaty to the chief of a strong Native American tribe, Lt. Billings (Robert Stack) and his troopers are in a race against time to avoid all-out war. Since time is of the essence, Billings recruits the chief's son, Taslik (Keith Larsen), to guide the men to the village. However, Billings and his men are unaware that a group of renegades, wary of the suspicious U.S. treaty, seek to kill the messengers before they can complete their mission.

scrippsnews.us.title: Photowalks On Scripps News - Atlanta
scrippsnews.us.description: Join Jefferson Graham of Photowalks to see the sights of Atlanta with Scripps News anchor Holly Firfer. Learn to take iconic pictures of the most walkable areas in the city.

scrippsnews.us.title: Photowalks On Scripps News - Indianapolis Family History
scrippsnews.us.description: Jefferson Graham takes Photowalks to his family's hometown of Indianapolis, Indiana to take photos of his grandparents' former home and see what other discoveries he can find in the public library records.

scrippsnews.us.title: Scripps Special: Years Million Stories ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
scrippsnews.us.description: Celebrating the impact and success of a powerful program, delivering the two millionth book to a child in our schools.

scrippsnews.us.title: Edge of Extinction: The Last Vaquita ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
scrippsnews.us.description: Exclusive access to the frontlines of a fight to save the world's most endangered marine mammal: the vaquita.

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - Shaquille O'Neal
scrippsnews.us.description: Shaquille O'Neal, who went from being poor and bullied to NBA stardom, reveals how his stepfather taught him the valuable lesson that "true pressure is not knowing where your next meal is coming from."

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - Kristen Bell
scrippsnews.us.description: Actress Kristen Bell recounts how her nurturing nature and her good works, such as co-founding No Kid Hungry, was sparked when she was age 19 and helped deliver two babies during a missionary trip to a clinic in Brazil.

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - Samuel L. Jackson & LaTanya Richardson Jackson
scrippsnews.us.description: Actors/spouses Samuel and LaTanya Jackson have fought for civil rights around the globe, but their greatest satisfaction comes from handwritten thank you notes from children they have supplied with books.

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - LeVar Burton
scrippsnews.us.description: Inspired by his mother to be "of service," LeVar Burton entered the seminary at 13 years old; after deciding the Church didn't have the answers to his life questions, he changed his focus to theater arts and became known for Roots and Star Trek.

secnetwork.us.title: The Paul Finebaum Show
secnetwork.us.description: Veteran writer, reporter and radio personality Paul Finebaum built a legion of loyal sports fans as the "Voice of the SEC" during 20 years hosting his Birmingham, Ala.-based radio talk show. When ESPN launched the SEC Network in 2014, it was only natural that Finebaum became its first on-air hire, bringing his radio show -- and those passionate followers -- with him. Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network.

secnetwork.us.title: Women's College Basketball - Southeastern Louisiana at Texas ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
secnetwork.us.description: The No. 6 Texas Longhorns clash with the Southeastern Louisiana Lady Lions in regular NCAA play. Texas looks to protect home court after beating Ohio State 75-61, while Southeastern Louisiana aims to rebound from a 74-68 defeat against Louisiana.

secnetwork.us.title: College Football - Wofford at Ole Miss
secnetwork.us.description: From Vaught-Hemingway Stadium in Oxford, Miss.

secnetwork.us.title: College Football - 2018 SEC Championship: Georgia vs. Alabama
secnetwork.us.description: Jalen Hurts comes off the bench to pass for one touchdown and run for another in the fourth quarter, rallying No. 1 Alabama to a win over No. 4 Georgia for the SEC championship. From Dec. 1, 2018.

secnetwork.us.title: College Football - 2020 SEC Championship: Florida vs. Alabama
College Football - SEC Championship: Georgia vs. Alabama
secnetwork.us.description: The No. 1 Bulldogs (12-0, 8-0) try to solve the No. 3 Crimson Tide (11-1, 7-1) in the SEC title game. Alabama has won six straight meetings since 2008, including the 2012 and 2018 SEC title tilts as well as the 2018 national championship game.

secnetwork.us.title: College Football - SEC Championship: LSU vs. Georgia
secnetwork.us.description: The Bulldogs face the Tigers in the 2022 SEC Championship Game from Atlanta. This is a rematch of the 2019 edition where Joe Burrow and LSU bested Georgia 37-10 en route to a national title. Georgia's last loss came in a 2021 match against Alabama. (sports) - 2022-12-03

shadesofblack.us.title: Crash
shadesofblack.us.description: Writer-director Paul Haggis interweaves several connected stories about race, class, family and gender in Los Angeles in the aftermath of 9/11. Characters include a district attorney (Brendan Fraser) and his casually prejudiced wife (Sandra Bullock), dating police detectives Graham (Don Cheadle) and Ria (Jennifer Esposito), a victimized Middle Eastern store owner and a wealthy African-American couple (Terrence Dashon Howard, Thandie Newton) humiliated by a racist traffic cop (Matt Dillon).

shadesofblack.us.title: Reasonable Doubt
shadesofblack.us.description: A prosecutor (Dominic Cooper) commits a fatal hit-and-run, then manipulates the case so that the man who was arrested for the crime is acquitted. After the trial, he discovers that his actions have freed a guilty man.

shadesofblack.us.title: 12 Rounds 3: Lockdown
shadesofblack.us.description: Framed for a homicide by his fellow officers, a detective (Dean Ambrose) tries to expose the conspiracy to clear his good name.

shadesofblack.us.title: As Good as Dead
shadesofblack.us.description: Bryant befriends a troubled teen and introduces him to martial arts. As Bryant's mysterious and dangerous past catches up to him, he is forced into a life and death struggle to clear his name, save the boy and get back all he left behind.

When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching. To his dismay, his new school is as full of dangerously undisciplined students as the last one, driving Trevor over the edge.

shadesofblack.us.title: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
shadesofblack.us.description: Jimmie and his best friend Mont try to reclaim the house built by Jimmie's grandfather, launching them on a poignant odyssey that connects them to their past, even as it tests their friendship and sense of belonging in the place they call home.

shadesofblack.us.title: Chaos
shadesofblack.us.description: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

shadesofblack.us.title: The Women of Brewster Place
shadesofblack.us.description: A multigenerational story of the lives of several black women who call an inner-city tenement home.

shadesofblack.us.title: In the Heat of the Night: Give Me Your Life
shadesofblack.us.description: As Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Harriet prepare to leave for their honeymoon, Forbes (Carl Weathers) clashes with a charismatic cult leader (Peter Fonda) who has arrived in Sparta.

shadesofblack.us.title: In the Heat of the Night: A Matter of Justice
shadesofblack.us.description: The trail of a serial killer leads the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) and police chief (Carl Weathers) to a prominent citizen in Sparta, Miss.

shoutmovies.us.title: Today You Die
shoutmovies.us.description: A world-class thief (Steven Seagal) escapes from prison to exact revenge on the partners who doubled-crossed him.

shoutmovies.us.title: Two for the Money
shoutmovies.us.description: A former college athlete (Matthew McConaughey) joins forces with a sports consultant (Al Pacino) to handicap football games for high-rolling gamblers.

shoutmovies.us.title: Spotlight
shoutmovies.us.description: Journalists (Mark Ruffalo, Michael Keaton, Rachel McAdams) from The Boston Globe investigate a cover-up of sexual abuse within the Roman Catholic Church.

shoutmovies.us.title: Once Upon a Time in China III
shoutmovies.us.description: A martial-arts master (Jet Li) defends his father from several gangs during a competition in Beijing.

shoutmovies.us.title: Tie Me Up! Tie Me Down!
shoutmovies.us.description: A former mental patient (Antonio Banderas) in Spain finds his porno-star dream girl (Victoria Abril) and ties her to her bed.

shoutmovies.us.title: Eraserhead
shoutmovies.us.description: When Henry discovers that a fling with Mary X leaves her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing.

shoutmovies.us.title: Infernal Affairs
shoutmovies.us.description: A troubled officer (Tony Leung) under deep cover and a corrupt cop (Andy Lau) each try to divine the other's identity within a crime lord's organization.

shoutmovies.us.title: Yakuza Wolf 2
shoutmovies.us.description: A man is sent to prison after being betrayed by a yakuza underboss and vows to take revenge. Once released, he attacks in a no-holds barred massacre.

shoutmovies.us.title: To Kill With Intrigue
shoutmovies.us.description: The Honeybee Flower gang kills everyone in Lei mansion but Siao Lei, spared by their leader because she likes him.

showtime.us.title: Noah
showtime.us.description: God chooses Noah (Russell Crowe) to build an ark and save the animals and his family from an apocalyptic flood.

showtime.us.title: Days of Thunder
showtime.us.description: An upstart stock-car driver goes to the edge for his manager, his brain-surgeon girlfriend and himself.

showtime.us.title: The Outsiders
showtime.us.description: In the 1960s Oklahoma a sensitive youth gets in over his head when his best friend kills a member of a rival gang.

showtime.us.title: Risky Business
showtime.us.description: A call-girl helps a Princeton applicant turn his home into a one-night brothel.

showtime.us.title: Top Gun
showtime.us.description: For Lieutenant Pete "Maverick" Mitchell and his friend and co-pilot Nick "Goose" Bradshaw, being accepted into an elite training school for fighter pilots is a dream come true. But a tragedy will threaten Pete's dreams of becoming an ace pilot.

showtime.us.title: Horrible Bosses
showtime.us.description: Three oppressed workers (Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis) devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to rid themselves of their intolerable employers.

showtime.us.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
showtime.us.description: As if creating the perfect Christmas for their families isn't hard enough, under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla will have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers during the holidays.

showtime.us.title: Tommy Boy
showtime.us.description: A ne'er-do-well auto-parts heir must stop his father's widow from selling the business.

showtime.us.title: Best in Show
showtime.us.description: Pampered pooches and their quirky owners converge on Philadelphia to compete in a prestigious dog show.

showtime.us.title: The King's Speech
showtime.us.description: An extraordinary friendship forms between England's King George VI (Colin Firth) and the Australian actor/speech therapist (Geoffrey Rush) who helps him overcome a stammer.

showtime.us.title: The Godfather
showtime.us.description: Crime boss Vito Corleone and his sons, the ruthless yet loyal members of the Corleone family, rule their secretive New York empire with an iron fist.

showtime.us.title: Rush Hour
showtime.us.description: A Hong Kong detective and a wisecracking L.A.P.D. detective choose to work together to find the missing daughter of a Chinese diplomat. (Movies, Action) - 1998

showtime2west.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
showtime2west.us.description: In 1935 archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford), a lounge singer (Kate Capshaw) and a Chinese orphan (Ke Huy Quan) search for mystical stones stolen from an Indian tribe.

showtime2west.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
showtime2west.us.description: Archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford) rescues his kidnapped father (Sean Connery), and the two race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail.

showtime2west.us.title: House at the End of the Street
showtime2west.us.description: A divorcee (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter (Jennifer Lawrence) learn that they have moved next door to a house in which a girl killed her parents, then disappeared, leaving a brother (Max Thieriot) as the only survivor.

showtime2west.us.title: Sweetness
showtime2west.us.description: When a fan learns that her rock-star idol is spiraling into addiction, she makes it her mission to save him, whether he wants her help or not. However, when her desperate plan spins out of control, she kidnaps him in a delusional attempt to fix him.

showtime2west.us.title: Se7en
showtime2west.us.description: A meticulous detective and the young officer about to replace the veteran probe serial murders based on the seven deadly sins.

showtime2west.us.title: Dexter: Resurrection
showtime2west.us.description: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right.

showtime2west.us.title: Red Eye
showtime2west.us.description: A plane passenger (Cillian Murphy) forcibly involves his seatmate (Rachel McAdams) in a plot to assassinate a government official.

showtime2west.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
showtime2west.us.description: Globe-trotting archaeologist Indiana Jones races the Nazis for possession of a legendary religious artifact.

showtime2west.us.title: Scrooge
showtime2west.us.description: Dickens' London miser Ebenezer Scrooge (Albert Finney) meets the spirits of Christmases past, present and yet to come.

showtime2west.us.title: The Intern
showtime2west.us.description: Dissatisfied with retirement, a 70-year-old widower becomes an intern at an online fashion site and develops a special bond with his young boss.

showtime2west.us.title: Risky Business
showtime2west.us.description: A call-girl helps a Princeton applicant turn his home into a one-night brothel.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Stop-Loss
showtimeextreme.us.description: His tour of duty in Iraq finally over, Staff Sgt. Brandon King returns home to Brazos, Texas, ready to re-enter civilian life. Unexpectedly, the Army invokes a clause in Brandon's military contract, requiring him to return to active duty in Iraq. With the help of close friend Michele, Brandon goes AWOL and struggles to find a way out of the dilemma.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
showtimeextreme.us.description: In Mexico City, a newly modified liquid Terminator -- the Rev-9 model -- arrives from the future to kill a young factory worker named Dani Ramos. Also sent back in time is Grace, a hybrid cyborg human who must protect Ramos from the seemingly indestructible robotic assassin. But the two women soon find some much-needed help from a pair of unexpected allies -- seasoned warrior Sarah Connor and the T-800 Terminator.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Fist Fight
showtimeextreme.us.description: On the last day before summer vacation, high school teacher Andy Campbell tries his best to keep it together amid senior pranks, a dysfunctional administration and budget cuts that threaten his job. Things go from bad to worse when he crosses Ron Strickland, the school's toughest and most feared teacher. When Strickland gets fired, he challenges Campbell to a fight after school. As news of the showdown spreads like wildfire, poor Andy desperately seeks any way out of his date with certain doom.

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Mexican
showtimeextreme.us.description: Brad Pitt stars as Jerry Welbach, a reluctant bagman, who has been given two ultimatums: The first is from his mob boss to travel to Mexico and retrieve a priceless antique pistol, known as "the Mexican"... or suffer the consequences. The second is from his girlfriend Samantha to end his association with the mob. Jerry figures alive and in trouble with Samantha is better than the more permanent alternative, so he heads south of the border.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Bad Santa 2
showtimeextreme.us.description: Fueled by cheap whiskey, greed and hatred, Willie Soke (Billy Bob Thornton) teams up with his angry little sidekick, Marcus, to knock off a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve. Along for the ride is chubby and cheery Thurman Merman, a 250-pound ray of sunshine who brings out Willie's sliver of humanity. Mommy issues arise when the pair are joined by Willie's horror story of a mother, Sunny Soke, who raises the bar for the gang's ambitions, while somehow lowering the standards of criminal behavior.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Bucket Lust
showtimeextreme.us.description: Ryan, given less than a year to live, must decide how to spend his final months. With platonic best friend Jennifer faking romance to ease his pain, and his buddy Seth pushing him to tackle his bucket list, Ryan confronts love, truth and mortality.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa
showtimeextreme.us.description: Irascible Irving Zisman and his young and impressionable grandson, Billy, set out on a road trip across America. Hidden cameras capture their insane and shocking encounters with a diverse set of unsuspecting citizens, including male strippers, disgruntled contestants (and their mothers) from a children's beauty pageant, mourners at a funeral home, patrons at a biker bar and more. Based on the "Jackass" TV series.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Star Trek: Section 31
showtimeextreme.us.description: Emperor Philippa Georgiou faces the sins of her past after joining a secret division of Starfleet that's tasked with protecting the United Federation of Planets.

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Manchurian Candidate
showtimeextreme.us.description: Years after his squad was ambushed during the Gulf War, Major Ben Marco (Denzel Washington) finds himself having terrible nightmares. He begins to doubt that his fellow squad-mate Sergeant Raymond Shaw (Liev Schreiber), now a vice-presidential candidate, is the hero he remembers him being. As Marco's doubts deepen, Shaw's political power grows, and, when Marco finds a mysterious implant embedded in his back, the memory of what really happened begins to return.

showtimeextreme.us.title: I Was a Stranger
showtimeextreme.us.description: Tragedy strikes a Syrian family in Aleppo, starting a chain reaction of events involving five different families in four different countries.

showtimeextreme.us.title: First Blood
showtimeextreme.us.description: Vietnam veteran and drifter John J. Rambo wanders into a small Washington town in search of an old friend, but is met with intolerance and brutality by the local sheriff, Will Teasle. When Teasle and his deputies restrain and shave Rambo, he flashes back to his time as a prisoner of war and unleashes his fury on the officers. He narrowly escapes the manhunt, but it will take his former commander to save the hunters from the hunted.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
showtimeextreme.us.description: John Rambo (Sylvester Stallone) is doing hard time in jail when his former boss, Col. Trautman (Richard Crenna), offers him a deal. If Rambo travels to Vietnam to try to find the American prisoners of war, his criminal record will be expunged. Rambo takes the reconnaissance assignment and agrees not to get involved in any of the action. However, when his Vietnamese lover, Co Bao (Julia Nickson), is killed by American forces, Rambo forgets his promise and takes matters into his own hands.

showtimefamily.us.title: Hotel for Dogs
showtimefamily.us.description: After moving into a foster home that forbids pets, siblings (Emma Roberts, Jake T. Austin) transform an abandoned hotel into a home for their pooch and a slew of stray dogs.

showtimefamily.us.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
showtimefamily.us.description: The world needed a hero and it got a hedgehog. Powered with incredible speed, Sonic races across the globe to stop uncool evil genius Dr. Robotnik from achieving world domination.

showtimefamily.us.title: Free Birds
showtimefamily.us.description: Two turkeys (Owen Wilson, Woody Harrelson) travel back in time to the year 1621 to prevent all feathered friends from ever becoming holiday dinners.

showtimefamily.us.title: The Lego Movie
showtimefamily.us.description: An ordinary LEGO figurine Emmet, thought to be the key to saving the world, is accompanied by a fellowship of strangers embarking on a quest to vanquish a tyrant bent on a terrible deed.

showtimefamily.us.title: Nancy Drew
showtimefamily.us.description: Accompanying her father on a business trip to Hollywood, the young sleuth (Emma Roberts) investigates the long-unsolved death of a movie star.

showtimefamily.us.title: View From the Top
showtimefamily.us.description: A woman (Gwyneth Paltrow) from a small Nevada town makes friends while training to become a flight attendant.

showtimefamily.us.title: Best in Show
showtimefamily.us.description: Pampered pooches and their quirky owners converge on Philadelphia to compete in a prestigious dog show.

showtimefamily.us.title: Three Wishes
showtimefamily.us.description: A frustrated family man recalls an encounter he (Joseph Mazzello), his widowed mom (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio) and his family had with a mysterious vagrant (Patrick Swayze) in 1955 suburbia.

showtimefamily.us.title: Hugo
showtimefamily.us.description: A resourceful orphaned boy (Asa Butterfield) and a bookish girl (Chloë Grace Moretz) set out on a quest to unlock a secret left to him by the boy's late father (Jude Law).

showtimefamily.us.title: Rango
showtimefamily.us.description: In the grip of an identity crisis, a sheltered chameleon accidentally winds up as the sheriff of a frontier town.

showtimefamily.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
showtimefamily.us.description: Globe-trotting archaeologist Indiana Jones races the Nazis for possession of a legendary religious artifact.

showtimefamily.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
showtimefamily.us.description: In 1935 archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford), a lounge singer (Kate Capshaw) and a Chinese orphan (Ke Huy Quan) search for mystical stones stolen from an Indian tribe.

showtimenext.us.title: Daniela Forever
showtimenext.us.description: After his girlfriend dies in an accident, a grieving man joins a sleep trial that allows him to rebuild his life with her through the use of lucid dreams.

showtimenext.us.title: Jersey Girl
showtimenext.us.description: Ollie Trinke is young and at the top of his game as a music promoter. He is both a workaholic and a silver-tongued expert at manipulating the press. At a company Christmas party, Ollie meets Gertrude Steiney, a book editor for a New York publishing house. They are instantly attracted to each other, and begin a whirlwind romance that changes the course of his personal and professional life.

showtimenext.us.title: Office Christmas Party
showtimenext.us.description: When the CEO (Jennifer Aniston) tries to close her hard-partying brother's (T.J. Miller) branch, he and his chief technical officer (Jason Bateman) must rally their co-workers and host an epic office Christmas party in an effort to impress a potential client and close a sale that will save their jobs.

showtimenext.us.title: Dear Santa
showtimenext.us.description: When a young boy mails his Christmas wish list to Santa with one crucial spelling error, a devilish Jack Black arrives to wreak havoc on the holidays.

showtimenext.us.title: A Wonderful Time of the Year
showtimenext.us.description: The Marsh family's getting together for their first Christmas Eve after three years of pandemic lockdown.

showtimenext.us.title: Fight or Flight
showtimenext.us.description: A mercenary takes on the job of tracking a high-value asset known only as "The Ghost" on an international flight. Realizing the plane is filled with assassins assigned to kill them both, the pair must work together in a fight for their lives.

showtimenext.us.title: The Autopsy of Jane Doe
showtimenext.us.description: When father and son coroners investigate the death of a beautiful "Jane Doe," they find increasingly bizarre clues.

showtimenext.us.title: Walking Out
showtimenext.us.description: When a city teen travels to Montana to go hunting with his estranged father, the trip becomes a battle for survival when they encounter a grizzly bear.

showtimenext.us.title: A Wonderful Time of the Year
showtimenext.us.description: The Marsh family's getting together for their first Christmas Eve after three years of pandemic lockdown.

showtimenext.us.title: Nothing Lasts Forever
showtimenext.us.description: The De Beers diamond cartel corners the market on love with the "A diamond is forever" catchphrase, but a wave of undetectable synthetic diamonds floods global gem markets, threatening to expose the artifice behind a multi-billion dollar industry. Featuring interviews with diamond merchants, De Beers execs, auctioneers, gemologists, designers, investigators and scientists.

showtimenext.us.title: Roadracers
showtimenext.us.description: In the 1950s, Dude Delaney (David Arquette) is a guitar-playing drifter who wanders into a quiet town looking to play music and generally cause trouble, much to the chagrin of the local sheriff (William Sadler). While palling around with his B-movie-obsessed friend, Nixer (John Hawkes), Dude meets a beautiful woman by the name of Donna (Salma Hayek), and is offered a position in a rockabilly band, but the sheriff is intent on getting rid of him by any means necessary.

showtimenext.us.title: The Cured
showtimenext.us.description: After years of a zombie plague that ravaged Europe, humanity grapples with how to reintegrate the former zombies into society.

showtimenext.us.title: Baby Driver
showtimenext.us.description: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom. (movie) - 2017

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Dunkirk
showtimeshowcase.us.description: In May 1940, Germany advanced into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. At the end of this heroic mission, 330,000 French, British, Belgian and Dutch soldiers were safely evacuated.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Hunt for Red October
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Based on the popular Tom Clancy novel, this suspenseful movie tracks Soviet submarine captain Marko Ramius as he abandons his orders and heads for the east coast of the United States. Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Argo
showtimeshowcase.us.description: On Nov. 4, 1979, militants storm the U.S. embassy in Tehran, Iran, taking 66 American hostages. Amid the chaos, six Americans manage to slip away and find refuge with the Canadian ambassador. Knowing that it's just a matter of time before the refugees are found and likely executed, the U.S. government calls on extractor Tony Mendez (Ben Affleck) to rescue them. Mendez's plan is to pose as a Hollywood producer scouting locations in Iran and train the refugees to act as his "film" crew.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Edge of Tomorrow
showtimeshowcase.us.description: When Earth falls under attack from invincible aliens, no military unit in the world is able to beat them. Maj. William Cage (Tom Cruise), an officer who has never seen combat, is assigned to a suicide mission. Killed within moments, Cage finds himself thrown into a time loop, in which he relives the same brutal fight -- and his death -- over and over again. However, Cage's fighting skills improve with each encore, bringing him and a comrade (Emily Blunt) ever closer to defeating the aliens.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Equalizer 2
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
showtimeshowcase.us.description: John Rambo (Sylvester Stallone) is doing hard time in jail when his former boss, Col. Trautman (Richard Crenna), offers him a deal. If Rambo travels to Vietnam to try to find the American prisoners of war, his criminal record will be expunged. Rambo takes the reconnaissance assignment and agrees not to get involved in any of the action. However, when his Vietnamese lover, Co Bao (Julia Nickson), is killed by American forces, Rambo forgets his promise and takes matters into his own hands.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Run & Gun
showtimeshowcase.us.description: After leaving a life of crime and violence, reformed good guy Ray enjoys a quiet family life in the suburbs. However, Ray's past comes back to haunt him as he gets blackmailed into one last job to collect a mysterious package. After a deadly double-cross, he soon finds himself wounded and on the run from ruthless assassins who will stop at nothing to get what he has.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Dear Santa
showtimeshowcase.us.description: When a young boy mails his Christmas wish list to Santa with one crucial spelling error, a devilish Jack Black arrives to wreak havoc on the holidays.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Dark Tower
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, is locked in an eternal battle with Walter O'Dim (Matthew McConaughey), also known as the Man in Black. The Gunslinger must prevent the Man in Black from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together. With the fate of worlds at stake, two men collide in the ultimate battle between good and evil.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: World Trade Center
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Two Port Authority officers, Sgt. John McLoughlin (Nicolas Cage) and Officer Will Jimeno (Michael Peña), become trapped in the rubble of the World Trade Center after going in to help people escape from the buildings during the terrorist attacks of Sept. 11, 2001.

showtimewomen.us.title: Restoration
showtimewomen.us.description: In order to keep one of his mistresses, Celia (Polly Walker), at arm's length, King Charles II (Sam Neill) asks the royal physician, Robert Merivel (Robert Downey Jr.), to marry her under the proviso that they never become intimate. Merivel agrees, only to discover he can't resist Celia, and soon finds himself out of the king's favor. Destitute, he devotes himself to helping Londoners suffering from the plague, and in the process falls in love with an equally poor woman, Katharine (Meg Ryan).

showtimewomen.us.title: Shakespeare in Love
showtimewomen.us.description: "Shakespeare in Love" is a romantic comedy for the 1990s set in the 1590s. It imaginatively unfolds the witty, sexy and timeless tale behind the creation of the greatest love story ever told. A young Shakespeare is out of cash and ideas; he meets his ideal woman and she inspires him to write one of his most famous plays.

showtimewomen.us.title: The Importance of Being Earnest
showtimewomen.us.description: Two young gents have taken to bending the truth in order to put some excitement into their lives. Worthing has invented a brother, Earnest, whom he uses as an excuse to leave his dull life behind to visit Gwendolen. Moncrieff decides to take the name Earnest when visiting Worthing's young and beautiful ward, Cecily. Things start to go awry when they end up together in the country and their deceptions are discovered.

showtimewomen.us.title: Mary Shelley
showtimewomen.us.description: Mary Wollstonecraft's family disapproves when she and poet Percy Shelley announce their love for each other. The family is horrified when it finds that the couple has eloped, accompanied by Mary's half-sister, Claire. While staying in the home of Lord Byron at Lake Geneva, the guests are challenged to write a ghost story, which leads Mary to conceive her novel Frankenstein.

showtimewomen.us.title: The English Patient
showtimewomen.us.description: The sweeping expanses of the Sahara are the setting for a passionate love affair in this adaptation of Michael Ondaatje's novel. A badly burned man, Laszlo de Almasy (Ralph Fiennes), is tended to by a nurse, Hana (Juliette Binoche), in an Italian monastery near the end of World War II. His past is revealed through flashbacks involving a married Englishwoman (Kristin Scott Thomas) and his work mapping the African landscape. Hana learns to heal her own scars as she helps the dying man.

showtimewomen.us.title: Alone in Berlin
showtimewomen.us.description: A German couple lose their son in WWII, prompting them to become secretly anti-Nazi.

showtimewomen.us.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
showtimewomen.us.description: Breaking up with Mark Darcy (Colin Firth) leaves Bridget Jones (Renée Zellweger) over 40 and single again. Feeling that she has everything under control, Jones decides to focus on her career as a top news producer. Suddenly, her love life comes back from the dead when she meets a dashing and handsome American named Jack (Patrick Dempsey). Things couldn't be better, until Bridget discovers that she is pregnant. Now, the befuddled mom-to-be must figure out if the proud papa is Mark or Jack.

showtimewomen.us.title: Failure to Launch
showtimewomen.us.description: A young man (Matthew McConaughey) continues to live at the home of parents who, in desperation to push him out of the nest once and for all, hatch a plan. They hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to assume the mantle of responsibility and get his own place.

showtimewomen.us.title: Everybody's Fine
showtimewomen.us.description: Eight months after the death of his wife, Frank Goode looks forward to a reunion with his four adult children. When all of them cancel their visits at the last minute, Frank, against the advice of his doctor, sets out on a road trip to reconnect with his offspring. As he visits each one in turn, Frank finds that his children's lives are not quite as picture-perfect as they've made them out to be.

showtimewomen.us.title: Breakfast at Tiffany's
showtimewomen.us.description: Based on Truman Capote's novel, this is the story of a young woman in New York City who meets a young man when he moves into her apartment building. He is with an older woman who is very wealthy, but he wants to be a writer. She is working as an expensive escort and searching for a rich, older man to marry. (movie) - 1961

showtimewomen.us.title: Racing With the Moon
showtimewomen.us.description: In their last weeks before deployment to World War II as Marines, teenage friends Henry Nash (Sean Penn) and Nicky (Nicolas Cage) try to make the best of the time they have left in their small California town. When Nash spots Caddie Winger (Elizabeth McGovern), a new girl in town he mistakenly believes to be wealthy, he sets about winning her over. But the good times are ruined when Nicky finds himself trying to solve a serious predicament, and implicating Nash and Caddie in the process. (movie) - 1984

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Silent Planet
shoxbetwest.us.description: Serving a life sentence alone on a distant planet, an aging convict must confront his past when a new prisoner arrives and forces him to remember his life on Earth.

shoxbetwest.us.title: 'Til Death Do Us Part
shoxbetwest.us.description: Michael and Madison Roland planned to spend the rest of their lives together, but Michael's controlling ways turn their perfect marriage into an abusive roller-coaster ride that no woman could survive. With the help of her best friend, Madison decides to get away. After adopting a new identity, she meets Alex Stone and learns to love again. All seems well until Michael discovers Madison's whereabouts and re-creates her nightmare.

shoxbetwest.us.title: Rules of Engagement
shoxbetwest.us.description: Col. Terry Childers (Samuel L. Jackson) is a 30-year Marine veteran: a decorated officer with combat experience in Vietnam, Beirut and Desert Storm -- a patriot, a hero. But now, the country he served so well has put him on trial for a rescue mission that went terribly wrong. For his attorney, he has chosen Marine Col. Hays Hodges (Tommy Lee Jones), a comrade-in-arms who owes his life to Childers.

shoxbetwest.us.title: Sleepless
shoxbetwest.us.description: Undercover Las Vegas police officer Vincent Downs (Jamie Foxx) finds himself caught in a high-stakes web of corrupt cops, internal affairs and murderous gangsters. When a failed heist leads to the kidnapping of his teenage son (Octavius J. Johnson), Downs must race against time during a wild and restless night to save him and bring the criminals to justice.

shoxbetwest.us.title: Heist 88

shoxbetwest.us.title: Regarding Us
shoxbetwest.us.description: After losing her teaching career in the Catholic school system, a transgender woman has a profound impact on the lives of two children, one with two fathers in marital strife, and the other a recent transplant from a conservative household. When the children form a unique bond, new questions and old prejudices erupt.

shoxbetwest.us.title: Imagine That

What everyone doesn't know is that Santa accomplishes the feat with a very high-tech operation beneath the North Pole. But when the unthinkable happens, and Santa misses one child out of hundreds of millions, someone has to save the day. It's up to Arthur (James McAvoy), Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns.

skysportstennis.uk.title: Murray v Nadal 2008

skysportstennis.uk.title: Del Potro v Federer 2009

skysportstennis.uk.title: Best of the WTA Finals

skysportstennis.uk.title: Best of the ATP Finals 2026

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That? - Water Bombers: Fixing Aerial Firefighters
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: With wildfire season ahead, Mike works with an aerial firefighting company as they fix and convert aircraft into firefighting machines, including the transformation of a 1960's C130 plane from aged military aircraft into a stateofthe art waterbomber. Water Bombers: Fixing Aerial Firefighters - S03E04

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That? - Deep Space Telescope
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: Host Mike Davidson goes to the remote Atacama Desert in Chile; at observatory ALMA he works alongside the expert team as they repair some of the world's biggest antennas. Deep Space Telescope - S02E02

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That? - Snowbird Ski Resort
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: Mike Davidson embarks with the team to one of the most extreme, avalanche-prone ski mountains in the world: Snowbird; they battle to keep the steep and deep slopes safe with shovels, snowcats and even a WWII Howitzer. Snowbird Ski Resort - S02E06

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That? - Monster Jam
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: At Monster Jam, custom-built monster trucks roll, flip and fly through the air; with the metal-bending beating these trucks endure, teams of specialized mechanics race against the clock to repair these engineering marvels in time for the next event. Monster Jam - S04E01

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That? - Cirque Du Soleil: High-Flying Fixes
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: At Cirque du Soleil in Las Vegas, Mike embeds with the talented teams that maintain the amazing machines behind Cirque du Soleil's stage shows. Cirque Du Soleil: High-Flying Fixes - S03E03

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That? - Afterburn
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: In Southern California, crews rebuild after the 2025 wildfires, cutting firebreaks, repairing emergency water systems, hardening roads and power lines and building fire-resistant homes before the next firestorm. Afterburn - S05E01

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That? - Sink Or Swim
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: Mike is in Indonesia, where sinking Jakarta battles floods with seawalls, pumps and reservoirs, while the new capital Nusantara is being built as a sponge city designed to absorb, store and reuse water instead of fighting it. Sink Or Swim - S05E07

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska - The Golden Eagle Has Landed
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: A bush pilot braves a dangerous landing on a frozen lake to save a bush guide's season. A helicopter pilot struggles with deep snow on a glacier, and two friends take a reborn airframe on its first flight in hopes of striking gold. The Golden Eagle Has Landed - S07E08

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: WWII's Most Daring Raids - Stealing Hitler's Radar
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: An elite group of British paratroopers launch a midnight raid in order to capture Hitler's unusual radar equipment. Stealing Hitler's Radar - S01E01

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: WWII's Most Daring Raids - Easy Company's First Assault
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: American paratroopers are dropped behind German lines on D-Day in order to secure territory behind the beaches. Easy Company's First Assault - S01E02

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: WWII's Most Daring Raids - Churchill Strikes Back
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: British Commandos raid two occupied Norwegian islands to wipe out fish oil factories used to make explosives. Churchill Strikes Back - S01E03

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: WWII's Most Daring Raids - Storming Mussolini's Island
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: The first invasion of the Italian Campaign of WWII: Operation Husky. Storming Mussolini's Island - S01E04

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: WWII's Most Daring Raids - Cutting Rommel's Lifeline
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: A secret British regiment in 1942 led a daring raid on a Nazi-occupied Libyan harbor. Cutting Rommel's Lifeline - S01E05

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: WWII's Most Daring Raids - Secret Weapon Sabotage
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: An elite squad of Norwegians destroy a power plant in 1943 that the Nazis may have been using for nuclear weapons research. Secret Weapon Sabotage - S01E06

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Battle of Midway: The True Story
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: America's first victory in the Pacific during World War II is retold from the vantage point of the three U.S. attack planes as they overcame the enemy ambush to face off against the Mitsubishi A6M Zero, a long-range fighter, in the air.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Race to Victory: WWII Pacific
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: The war was over in Europe but in the Pacific one of the bloodiest battles was being fought; a look at the bloody and history-altering final 100 days of the Pacific War, shown through rare war footage and first-person accounts.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Cowboy Up
sonymoviechannel.us.description: Hank (Kiefer Sutherland) and Ely Braxton (Marcus Thomas) are brothers and rivals. They're each haunted by the specter of their dad, Reid (Pete Postlethwaite), a famous bull rider turned absent father. Hank is a rodeo clown who breeds bulls; Ely is a brash young rider who won't let anything -- not even life-threatening injuries -- keep him out of the ring. When rodeo sweetheart Celia (Daryl Hannah) gets between them, sibling rivalry grows volatile and loyalties are tested.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Redbelt
sonymoviechannel.us.description: Martial artist Mike Terry (Chiwetel Ejiofor) lives by a strict code of no competitions, for he feels that such contests weaken fighters. After saving a famous action star (Tim Allen) from a brutal attack, Mike takes a job in the film industry. He soon finds his personal beliefs and integrity on the line as circumstances force him to participate in a prize fight.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Blood and Bone
sonymoviechannel.us.description: In Los Angeles, an ex-con takes the underground fighting world by storm in his quest to fulfill a promise to a dead friend.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: The Shepherd
sonymoviechannel.us.description: A border-patrol agent (Jean-Claude Van Damme) must stop renegade Special Forces soldiers from smuggling heroin into the United States.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Gladiator
sonymoviechannel.us.description: After whipping a rival in a brawl, Chicago teen Tommy Riley (James Marshall) is asked to box in the illegal fights organized by Jimmy Horn (Brian Dennehy). Tommy has bigger aspirations, but when Jimmy agrees to cover the betting debts his father (John Heard) incurred, Tommy agrees. He soon befriends Abraham Lincoln Haines (Cuba Gooding Jr.), a black boxer helping to support his family. When Jimmy realizes that the friends are his two top draws, he matches them in a bout neither wants.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Mercenary
sonymoviechannel.us.description: An electronics mogul (John Ritter) coerces a former commander (Olivier Gruner) into helping him find the terrorist who killed his wife.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Planet Action
sonymoviechannel.us.description: A look at how celebrities are stepping up to make a difference in the world and hopefully inspiring others to do the same.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: The Deep
sonymoviechannel.us.description: Undersea adventure about a couple who become involved in a dangerous conflict with treasure hunters when they discover a deadly shipwreck in Bermudan waters. When they realize that the cache includes morphine, the pair enlist the help of an old treasure hunter to escape the drug dealers who hid their product amidst the sunken wreck.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Limbo
sonymoviechannel.us.description: After a traumatic accident years ago that left others dead, Joe Gastineau has lived a life full of guilt, leading a solitary existence as a fisherman in Alaska. After he meets lounge singer Donna, he starts to fall for her and open up. However, when Joe's half brother returns, asking for help, it sends Joe, Donna and her daughter, Noelle, on a boat ride that will change their lives.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Hudson Hawk
sonymoviechannel.us.description: Thief extraordinaire Hudson Hawk has just been released from prison and all he wants is a nice cappuccino. However, before he can savor his favorite beverage, the highly eccentric and wealthy Darwin Mayflower and his equally odd wife, Minerva, rope Hawk into an ambitious series of heists. Soon Hawk is stealing no less than major works by Leonardo da Vinci, priceless pieces that the Mayflowers plan to use in an exceedingly nefarious way.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Sunset
sonymoviechannel.us.description: Having retired from a life of gunfights and peacekeeping, the great Wyatt Earp (James Garner) has landed a job as adviser to a Western movie about himself. On the set of the silent picture, he gets to know Tom Mix (Bruce Willis), an actor who specializes in Westerns, who has been hired to portray Earp. Not long after making each other's acquaintance, they find out that Earp's ex-girlfriend's son is missing, and the man responsible may be studio chief Alfie Alperin (Malcolm McDowell).

spectrumoc16.us.title: Ninth Island Connection
spectrumoc16.us.description: Talk with Plaza CEO Jonathan Jossel, former mayor and attorney-to-the-mob Oscar Goodman, and Chef Ben Jenkins of Oscar's Steakhouse.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Dut's Grindz & Goodtimes
spectrumoc16.us.description: Learn what goes into a traditional street dog at the Eastside Kitchen food truck.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Painting in Paradise ᴺᵉʷ
spectrumoc16.us.description: Hawaii's Nature Artist Patrick Ching takes local ohana on nature adventures then shows them and the television audience how to draw and paint their favorite things.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Outside Hawaii
spectrumoc16.us.description: Dr. Michael Nishime discusses the advancement of dental technology. Former Hawaii State Fish and Game head and member of the 442nd Regimental Combat Team, Kenji Ego, became a marine biologist after war and helped to conserve Hawaii's ocean resources.

spectrumoc16.us.title: The Joy of Crafting
spectrumoc16.us.description: Ellie Tsusaki shows us how to coil wire into a Christmas tree for festive earrings. Then, Tyra Takahashi shows a simple technique for modern calligraphy. And Jennier Deien has a retro craft, plastic canvas cozies.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Fashion Sense by Valerie
spectrumoc16.us.description: Valerie styles playful polka dots; Dr. Hanna discusses bone health; Gina shares a side stretch and Denise shares tips to impress homebuyers; pumpkin pie s'mores and a festive cranberry mocktail!

spectrumoc16.us.title: Showcase Hawaii
spectrumoc16.us.description: Celebrate Hawaii's beauty with the Hawaiian Scroll Adjustable Bracelets, featuring an elegant scroll design in gold or silver-plated brass. Adjustable sizes 7.5 to 9 for all, it's a timeless gift for any occasion.

spectrumoc16.us.title: The Champ Show
spectrumoc16.us.description: Join Champ as he visits local establishments and shows you the products and services they offer, including tasting the cuisine of Hawaii's eateries.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Upside Down Pilates
spectrumoc16.us.description: Lisa Orig and her team will help get you in shape with exercises that will strengthen and tone your entire body.

spectrumoc16.us.title: The Pet Hui
spectrumoc16.us.description: Visit the Mega Monster Mash and meet an unusual pet, the Ukrainian Levkoy; it is a medium-sized cat breed known for its hairless or peach-fuzz body, wrinkled skin, folded ears and angular, dog-like profile.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Board Stories
spectrumoc16.us.description: From Pipeline to Jaws, Brazil to El Salvador, Mike Latronic chases the world's best surf; slo-mo barrels, top-level free surfing, and monster big waves, shot with Brent Bielmann.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Flippin Uce
spectrumoc16.us.description: With city inspectors giving the green light, it's full steam ahead; crews install drywall while electricians prep new lighting and outlets; concrete is poured for walkways, a ramp and fencing; the project's vision is coming to life.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Hawaiian Xtreme Sports TV
spectrumoc16.us.description: It's all about giant winter surf on Oahu's and Maui's North Shores; as some of the largest surf in over a decade rolls in, we witness as daredevils from around the globe push the limits.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Ocean Paddler TV
spectrumoc16.us.description: Travel to the Garden Isle for the OC1 races of the Kauai World Challenge. And travel to Maui for the sailing canoe Waa Kiakahi crossing to Molokai.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Cooking Hawaiian Style
spectrumoc16.us.description: Jennifer Zelko-Schlueter, Manager of Government and Community Relations at Hawaii Electric Light Company, not only shares what they've been doing in our community, but her delicious Tofu Stir Fry recipe as well!

spectrumoc16.us.title: Hawaii Skin Diver ᴺᵉʷ
spectrumoc16.us.description: Hawaii Skin Divers are on the hunt for fresh salmon and halibut in Homer, Alaska.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Sports People Hawaii
spectrumoc16.us.description: Gary Shim overcame injuries to be one of the top powerlifters in the state. The Hawaii Harlequins rugby team has been in Hawaii for over 50 years. Tips on running correctly to avoid injuries.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Board Stories ᴺᵉʷ
spectrumoc16.us.description: Highlights from the Surfer Awards show. European riders get a dose of magic in the Mediterranean. The artist Hula makes a special tribute mural for Andy Irons. A magical day of tube riding at Pipeline.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Ultimate Japan
spectrumoc16.us.description: Ride in style on a ferry to beautiful Sado Island. Then in Sado, the group has a unique kind of lunch and experiences plant dyeing. They end the day with a delicious Japanese-style dinner.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Here in Hawaii ᴺᵉʷ
spectrumoc16.us.description: Uplifting stories about people keeping the aloha spirit alive.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Lanai's Travel Club
