stadium.us.title: Ozzy and Jack's World Detour - Blizzard of Oz
stadium.us.description: Ozzy and Jack arrive in Alaska, and abandon the RV; Ozzy plans a nautical surprise for Jack, but loses his most valuable possession.

stadium.us.title: Ozzy and Jack's World Detour - Aloha, Osbournes
stadium.us.description: Ozzy and Jack thank their wives for holding down the fort during their adventure with a trip to the Big Island of Hawaii; Jack and Lisa's two young daughters manage to turn every family outing upside down.

stadium.us.title: Ozzy and Jack's World Detour - Twisted Sister
stadium.us.description: Ozzy is hounded to do press, promos and photos for his final world tour; needing to stay behind in Los Angeles for his baby's birth, Jack conspires to convince his sister, Kelly, to take the wheel and hit the road with Ozzy.

stadium.us.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter - Bounty Boot Camp
stadium.us.description: Dog's longtime friend and fellow bondsman, Jim, has a son who has just started in the family business; Dog takes Jim's son along for some training as he tracks down a potentially dangerous fugitive.

stadium.us.title: Ozzy and Jack's World Detour - Kelly of the Beast
stadium.us.description: With Jack stuck in Los Angeles waiting for his baby to be born, sister Kelly hops into the driver's seat; in Arizona, Ozzy and Kelly tour the Biosphere and bond over a night of beauty masks.

stadium.us.title: Ozzy and Jack's World Detour - Kelly Makes Three
stadium.us.description: Following the birth of his baby, Jack returns to traveling with Ozzy and his sister, Kelly; in New Mexico, the group samples chili milkshakes and learns to make pistachios; Kelly finds a way to make a profit from Ozzy and Jack's guy humor.

stadium.us.title: Ozzy and Jack's World Detour - I Am Ice Cream Man
stadium.us.description: In Missouri, Kelly takes the guys to eat some fresh ice cream, while Jack arranges a trip to an "explosion school"; Jack and Kelly plan some touching surprises for Ozzy; old nemesis "Robert the Doll" returns and threatens to derail the trip.

stadium.us.title: Ozzy and Jack's World Detour - Grand Ole Osbournes
stadium.us.description: Kelly leads a trip to Nashville, Tenn., where the activities include a drag queen brunch and restyling Ozzy's Madame Tussauds' wax figure; Kelly plans a musical surprise for Ozzy, and squeezes in a quick trip to the largest ashram in the country.

stadium.us.title: Cold Case Files - Killer on the Strip; The Doll Murder
stadium.us.description: A determined cop solves the murder of a prostitute; investigators solve the murder of a socialite.

stadium.us.title: Cold Case Files - The Burning Secret; Justice Delayed
stadium.us.description: A woman kills her husband in a satanic rite; a woman tracks down the man who raped her.

stadium.us.title: American Justice - Murder by Mercedes
stadium.us.description: A Houston dentist is accused of running down her adulterous husband with her car.

stadium.us.title: American Justice - The Happy Face Killer
stadium.us.description: Two innocent people confess to a serial killer's crimes.

stadium.us.title: The Aging Brain
stadium.us.description: Learn what's behind mental decline with age, and how to improve memory, focus and concentration with NeuroQ's Darrin Peterson and Dale Bredesen MD.

starttv.us.title: Rizzoli & Isles - No More Drama in My Life

starttv.us.title: The Closer - Old Money
starttv.us.description: After one of Brenda's detectives is ambushed on the street, the investigation turns into a race to clear the detective's name over allegations of witness tampering.

starttv.us.title: The Closer - High Crimes
starttv.us.description: The Chief of Police assigns Major Crimes a case involving the armed robbery of several medical marijuana dispensaries; Brenda is tested on her readiness to move up in the department.

starttv.us.title: Major Crimes - Penalty Phase
starttv.us.description: The team tracks an unhinged killer who is making his own film with his victims as the stars; a new romance takes wing.

starz.us.title: Paul
starz.us.description: For the past 60 years, a wisecracking alien named Paul (Seth Rogen) has resided at a top-secret military base in America's UFO heartland. When Paul decides he has had enough of Earth, he escapes from the compound and hops on the first handy vehicle -- a rented RV manned by two British sci-fi nerds named Graeme (Simon Pegg) and Clive (Nick Frost). With federal agents and the father of an accidental kidnap victim on their tail, the two hatch a crazy plan to help Paul return to his spaceship.

starz.us.title: Power Ballad
starz.us.description: When Rick, a past-his-prime wedding singer, meets fading boy-band star Danny during a gig, the two bond over music and a late-night jam session. But when Danny turns one of Rick's songs into the hit that reignites his career, Rick sets out to reclaim the recognition he believes he deserves, even if it means risking everything he cares about.

starz.us.title: Oscar Shaw
starz.us.description: Haunted by the tragic loss of his closest friend, a retired detective embarks on a perilous quest for vengeance as he fights to restore justice to the streets he once protected.

starz.us.title: Jurassic World
starz.us.description: Located off the coast of Costa Rica, the Jurassic World luxury resort provides a habitat for an array of genetically engineered dinosaurs, including the vicious and intelligent Indominus rex. When the massive creature escapes, it sets off a chain reaction that causes the other dinos to run amok. Now, it's up to a former military man and animal expert to use his special skills to save two young brothers and the rest of the tourists from an all-out, prehistoric assault.

starz.us.title: Alarum
starz.us.description: Living off the grid while vacationing at a winter resort, married spies Joe and Lara come under fire from members of the old guard who suspect they've joined an elite team of rogue spies.

starz.us.title: Fifty Shades of Grey (Extended Version)
starz.us.description: When college senior Anastasia Steele (Dakota Johnson) steps in for her sick roommate to interview prominent businessman Christian Grey (Jamie Dornan) for their campus paper, little does she realize the path her life will take. Christian, as enigmatic as he is rich and powerful, finds himself strangely drawn to Ana, and she to him. Though sexually inexperienced, Ana plunges headlong into an affair -- and learns that Christian's true sexual proclivities push the boundaries of pain and pleasure.

starz.us.title: Enough
starz.us.description: Working-class waitress Slim (Jennifer Lopez) finds her life transformed when she marries wealthy contractor Mitch (Billy Campbell). She settles into an idyllic suburban life and seems to have everything she wants. Her dream is shattered when she discovers her husband is anything but perfect. His abusive behavior forces her to go on the run, eluding an increasingly obsessive Mitch and his lethal henchman.

starz.us.title: Pain & Gain
starz.us.description: Danny Lupo (Mark Wahlberg), manager of the Sun Gym in the 1990s Miami, decides that there is only one way to achieve his version of the American dream: extortion. To achieve his goal, he recruits musclemen Paul (Dwayne Johnson) and Adrian (Anthony Mackie) as accomplices. After several failed attempts, they abduct rich businessman Victor Kershaw (Tony Shalhoub) and convince him to sign over all his assets to them. But when Kershaw makes it out alive, authorities are reluctant to believe his story.

starz.us.title: Beast
starz.us.description: After years away from the cage, a once-feared MMA champion is pulled back in for the fight of his life when his younger brother is put in danger. Reuniting with the trainer who once made him a legend, he commits to one final showdown against the reigning title-holder: a brutal fighter determined to dismantle the ex-champ's legacy in front of the world. Pushed to his breaking point, the contender's stakes are simple: win, or lose everything he's built. (movie) - 2026

starz.us.title: The Preacher's Wife
starz.us.description: A cleric begins to doubt himself and is visited by an angel. The heavenly emissary is supposed to help the good reverend over his midlife crisis, but he is distracted by the cleric's lovely young wife. A remake with gospel music of the "The Bishop's Wife". (movie) - 1996

starzcinema.us.title: Hostiles
starzcinema.us.description: In 1892, legendary Army Capt. Joseph Blocker reluctantly agrees to escort a dying Cheyenne war chief and his family back to their tribal land. Embarking on a harrowing and perilous journey from Fort Berringer, N.M., to the grasslands of Montana, they soon encounter a young widow whose family was killed on the plains. The travelers must now band together to survive a punishing landscape that's crawling with hostile Comanches and vicious outlaws.

starzcinema.us.title: The Promise
starzcinema.us.description: Brilliant medical student Michael (Oscar Isaac) meets beautiful dance instructor Ana (Charlotte Le Bon) in late 1914. Their shared Armenian heritage sparks an attraction that explodes into a romantic rivalry between Michael and Ana's boyfriend (Christian Bale), an American photojournalist who's dedicated to exposing the truth. As the Ottoman Empire crumbles into war-torn chaos, their conflicting passions must be deferred as they join forces to get themselves and their people to safety.

starzcinema.us.title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
starzcinema.us.description: Obsessed with cars since childhood, inventor Preston Tucker (Jeff Bridges) has his first successful auto design partnership in the 1930s and designs a successful gun turret for World War II use. With those achievements under his belt, Tucker is determined to create a futuristic car for the masses: the Tucker Torpedo. However, his dreams are challenged by Detroit's auto manufacturers, production problems and accusations of stock fraud, and he is forced to defend his dream and honesty in court.

starzcinema.us.title: Fierce People
starzcinema.us.description: Finn (Anton Yelchin) is a teenager trying to escape his drug-addicted mother (Diane Lane) by going to study tribal people. His hopes are dashed when he gets caught scoring drugs for her, and she decides to start their lives over by moving them in with her massage client, billionaire Ogden (Donald Sutherland). At first, Finn indulges in the luxury around him and falls for Ogden's granddaughter (Kristen Stewart), but he soon finds that the rich can be more savage than any group in the wild.

starzcinema.us.title: Dìdi
starzcinema.us.description: In 2008, during the last month of summer before high school begins, an impressionable 13-year-old Taiwanese American boy learns what his family can't teach him: how to skate, how to flirt, and how to love his mom.

starzcinema.us.title: Lesbian Vampire Killers
starzcinema.us.description: Two best buddies (James Corden, Mathew Horne) encounter a nest of beautiful Sapphic bloodsuckers.

starzcinema.us.title: The Parts You Lose
starzcinema.us.description: A fugitive forms an unlikely bond with a deaf child when he takes refuge in an abandoned barn on the boy's family's farm.

starzcinema.us.title: It Only Takes a Night
starzcinema.us.description: After one of them experiences a brutal breakup, four friends go on a wild night out. Meant to be a distraction, the night turns into a life-altering series of events none of them will ever forget.

starzcinema.us.title: 2 Days in Paris
starzcinema.us.description: A European vacation was intended to repair the tattered relationship between American Jack (Adam Goldberg) and French native Marion (Julie Delpy). But, by the time they arrive in Paris to visit Marion's family, it is clear the trip is not going well. The city brings out aspects of Marion that only alienate neurotic Jack further, from her in-your-face politics to her former boyfriends, who surface in every café. Thus, the most romantic city in the world could mean the end of the couple's romance.

starzcinema.us.title: Whitney Houston in Focus
starzcinema.us.description: The untold story of photographer Bette Marshall and her one-time muse, an unknown eighteen-year-old singer the world would come to know as Whitney Houston.

starzcinema.us.title: Death Defying Acts
starzcinema.us.description: Upon arriving in Edinburgh, Scotland for a series of mind-boggling performances, master illusionist Harry Houdini (Guy Pearce) offers an impressive cash reward to any supposed psychic who can accurately tell him his late mother's exact last words. Gorgeous swindler Mary McGarvie (Catherine Zeta-Jones) rises to the challenge and engages Houdini in a dangerous flirtation that will blur the line between reality and paranoia -- and test the very limits of his skepticism.

starzcinema.us.title: The Girl in the Spider's Web
starzcinema.us.description: Fired from the National Security Agency, Frans Balder recruits hacker Lisbeth Salander to steal Firewall, a computer program that can access codes for nuclear weapons worldwide. The download soon draws attention from an NSA agent who traces the activity to Stockholm. Further problems arise when Russian thugs take Lisbeth's laptop and kidnap a math whiz who can make Firewall work. Now, Lisbeth and an unlikely ally must race against time to save the boy and recover the codes to avert disaster. (movie) - 2018

starzcomedy.us.title: A Happening of Monumental Proportions
starzcomedy.us.description: Administrators at an elementary school scramble to hide a dead body from students and parents on Career Day.

starzcomedy.us.title: Last Chance Harvey
starzcomedy.us.description: In London for his daughter's wedding, a struggling jingle-writer, Harvey Shine (Dustin Hoffman), misses his plane to New York, and thus loses his job. While drowning his sorrows in the airport pub, Harvey meets Kate (Emma Thompson), a British government worker stuck in an endless cycle of work, phone calls from her mother, and blind dates. A connection forms between the unhappy pair, who soon find themselves falling in love.

starzcomedy.us.title: Small Time
starzcomedy.us.description: A young man (Devon Bostick) decides to skip college and join his father (Christopher Meloni) as a used-car salesman.

starzcomedy.us.title: The Details
starzcomedy.us.description: Seemingly blind to the actual cracks in his marriage, a doctor (Tobey Maguire) blames a family of destructive raccoons for the problems in his home life.

starzcomedy.us.title: Thoroughbreds
starzcomedy.us.description: Childhood friends Lily and Amanda reconnect in suburban Connecticut after years of growing apart. Lily has turned into a polished upper-class teenager who has a fancy boarding school on her transcript and a coveted internship on her resume. Amanda has developed a sharp wit and her own particular attitude but all in the process of becoming a social outcast. Though they initially seem completely at odds, the pair eventually bond and hatch a plan to solve both of their problems.

starzcomedy.us.title: Boy Eats Girl
starzcomedy.us.description: After declaring his love to his girlfriend, a teenager dies and comes back as a flesh-craving zombie.

starzcomedy.us.title: The Break-Up
starzcomedy.us.description: When Brooke (Jennifer Aniston), an art dealer, and Gary (Vince Vaughn), a tour-bus driver, finally call it quits in their relationship, neither is willing to move out of their shared condo. With their friends suggesting a series of underhanded tactics that fail to get either Brooke or Gary to cave in, the only solution is to become hostile roommates.

starzcomedy.us.title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
starzcomedy.us.description: An advice columnist, Andie Anderson (Kate Hudson), tries pushing the boundaries of what she can write about in her new piece about how to get a man to leave you in 10 days. Her editor, Lana (Bebe Neuwirth), loves it, and Andie goes off to find a man she can use for the experiment. Enter executive Ben Berry (Matthew McConaughey), who is so confident in his romantic prowess that he thinks he can make any woman fall in love with him in 10 days. When Andie and Ben meet, their plans backfire.

starzcomedy.us.title: Barefoot
starzcomedy.us.description: The black sheep of a wealthy family brings a naive, sheltered young woman (Evan Rachel Wood) home for his brother's wedding.

starzcomedy.us.title: Bandslam
starzcomedy.us.description: A gifted singer/songwriter, Charlotte hires Will Burton, a new guy in town, to manage her fledgling rock band. She wants one thing from him: to help her win a contest against her ex-boyfriend in an upcoming battle of the bands. Charlotte's band comes together and seems to have a real shot at victory, while Will and dynamic guitarist Sa5m begin to make some beautiful music of their own.

starzcomedy.us.title: No Strings Attached
starzcomedy.us.description: Lifelong friends Emma (Natalie Portman) and Adam (Ashton Kutcher) take their relationship to the next level by having sex. Afraid of ruining their friendship, the new lovers make a pact to keep things purely physical, with no fighting, no jealousy and no expectations. Emma and Adam pledge to do whatever they want, wherever they want, as long as they do not fall in love. The question then becomes: Who will fall first?

starzedge.us.description: A young woman (Britt Robertson) chronicles her sexual adventures in an anonymous blog that exposes her innermost desires, shames and secrets.

starzedge.us.title: Serendipity
starzedge.us.description: On a magical night when they are in their 20s, Jonathan (John Cusack) meets Sara (Kate Beckinsale). He finds it love at first sight, but Sara believes in destiny. After 10 years the two -- with 3,000 miles between them -- must decide if fate wants them to be together again. When love feels like magic, it is called destiny; when destiny has a sense of humor, it is serendipity.

starzedge.us.title: The Call
starzedge.us.description: A veteran operator for an emergency call-center, Jordan (Halle Berry) saves lives daily as part of her job, but when a young woman's frantic report of a prowler ends tragically, Jordan is devastated. She decides to pack it in on the front lines and -- instead -- teach others the ropes of the high-pressure job. But when a call from a kidnapped teen (Abigail Breslin) comes in, Jordan takes charge as never before and turns the girl into a partner in helping to save her life.

starzedge.us.title: Outlander: Blood of my Blood - Another Man's Shadow
starzedge.us.description: Colum experiences a tragedy, and Maura uses the opportunity to encourage Dougal to lead; Murtagh defends Grace from harm, with ramifications for their relationship; Henry watches as a new romance unfolds.

starzedge.us.title: The Night Before
starzedge.us.description: For the last 10 years, lifelong buddies Ethan (Joseph Gordon-Levitt), Isaac (Seth Rogen) and Chris (Anthony Mackie) have gathered on Christmas Eve to celebrate the holidays with a bang. As Isaac prepares to become a first-time father, the friends realize that their annual tradition is coming to a sad end. To make it as memorable as possible, they plan a night of debauchery and hilarity by searching for the Nutcracka Ball, the Holy Grail of Christmas parties in New York.

starzedge.us.title: The Brothers Bloom
starzedge.us.description: Twenty-five years of swindling people are too much for Bloom, and he wants out of the business. His brother, Stephen, convinces him to work on one final hustle, targeting an eccentric East Coast heiress named Penelope. The con game fails to play out as planned when Bloom falls in love with the irresistible woman.

starzedge.us.title: Mariah Carey: Merry Christmas to All!
starzedge.us.description: The singer-songwriter performs a repertoire of her festive holiday hits, including the chart-topping perennial favorite "All I Want for Christmas Is You."

starzedge.us.title: A Christmas Scam
starzedge.us.description: When missing money threatens his annual Christmas concert, an R&B singer confronts a trusted friend's betrayal. But a hidden illness and an unexpected family connection reveal a more complicated truth.

starzedge.us.title: Adam Sandler's Eight Crazy Nights
starzedge.us.description: Davey Stone, a 33-year-old party animal, finds himself in trouble with the law after his wild ways go too far. In keeping with the holiday spirit, the judge gives Davey one last chance at redemption, spend the holiday performing community service as the assistant referee for the youth basketball league or go to jail. Davey thinks he's gotten off easy until he meets Whitey Duvall, the eccentric, elf-like head referee.

starzedge.us.title: In the Grey
starzedge.us.description: A covert team of elite operatives live in the global shadows, as comfortable wielding power and influence as they are automatic weapons and high explosives. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, the team is sent to steal it back on what would be for anyone else a suicide mission. What begins as an impossible heist gets worse, spiraling into an all-out war of strategy, deception and survival.

Now a fugitive, Salt must use every skill gained from years of training and experience to evade capture, but the more she tries to prove her innocence, the more guilty she seems.

Leaving a lipstick drawing of her namesake on every victim, Cataleya carries out her assignments with efficiency and dreams of avenging her family. (movie) - 2011

starzencore.us.description: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit.

Knowing that he must employ a similar strategy, President Will Cooper (Kevin James) recruits his childhood pal, former video-game champ and home-theater installer Sam Brenner (Adam Sandler), to lead a team of old-school arcade players and a military specialist (Michelle Monaghan) in an all-out battle to save the planet.

starzencore.us.title: The Longest Yard
starzencore.us.description: Disgraced pro football quarterback Paul Crewe (Adam Sandler) lands in jail, where manipulative Warden Hazen (James Cromwell) recruits him to advise the institution's team. This turns into a lead role quarterbacking a crew of inmates in a game against a team of prison guards. Aided by incarcerated ex-NFL coach Nate Scarborough (Burt Reynolds), Crewe and his team must overcome not only the bloodthirstiness of the opposition, but also the corrupt officials trying to fix the game against them.

starzencoreaction.us.description: In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.

With any luck, the ocean currents may carry him into a shipping lane -- but, with supplies dwindling and the sharks circling, the sailor is forced to face his own mortality.

Questioned by a detective, the couple and their two children try to safeguard one another's secrets. However, the choices they make soon lead to consequences even graver than they could have imagined.

starzencoreblack.us.title: The Strangers: Chapter 3
starzencoreblack.us.description: Maya squares off against the masked killers one last time in a brutal, full-circle reckoning of survival and revenge.

starzkids&family.us.title: Apple Mortgage Cake
starzkids&family.us.description: To avoid losing her home to foreclosure, single mother Angela Logan (Kimberly Elise) tries to bake and sell 100 apple cakes in 10 days.

starzkids&family.us.title: The Perfect Holiday
starzkids&family.us.description: Nancy (Gabrielle Union), a divorced mother of three, feels especially lonely during the holidays. Sensing her sadness, Nancy's youngest daughter, Emily (Khail Bryant), has a plan to make her mom happy again. She asks Benjamin (Morris Chestnut), a department-store Santa Claus, to pay Nancy a compliment. And Benjamin, who is also a struggling songwriter, knows exactly the right words to say.

starzkids&family.us.title: The Dog Who Saved Summer
starzkids&family.us.description: After their dog Zeus ruins a party, George takes him to an obedience school run by a no-nonsense instructor. When Zeus manages to fail every test, he seeks help from a trainer with special techniques.

starzkids&family.us.title: A Dog and Pony Show
starzkids&family.us.description: Dede, a famous performing circus dog, gets left behind when her show leaves town. When she is adopted by a lonely boy on a farm, the vain dog has to learn to get along with the other animals.

starzkids&family.us.title: The Winning Season
starzkids&family.us.description: Increasingly estranged from his own daughter, a boozy busboy (Sam Rockwell) gets a shot at redemption when an old friend (Rob Corddry) hires him to coach a varsity girls basketball team. (movie) - 2009

starzwest.us.title: The Furious
starzwest.us.description: After Wang Wei's daughter is kidnapped by a criminal network, his only ally is Navin, a journalist whose wife has mysteriously disappeared. Fueled by a furious vengeance, the unlikely duo finds themselves in an explosive martial-arts showdown against a relentless gang of thugs.

starzwest.us.title: Paul
starzwest.us.description: For the past 60 years, a wisecracking alien named Paul (Seth Rogen) has resided at a top-secret military base in America's UFO heartland. When Paul decides he has had enough of Earth, he escapes from the compound and hops on the first handy vehicle -- a rented RV manned by two British sci-fi nerds named Graeme (Simon Pegg) and Clive (Nick Frost). With federal agents and the father of an accidental kidnap victim on their tail, the two hatch a crazy plan to help Paul return to his spaceship.

starzwest.us.title: Power Ballad
starzwest.us.description: When Rick, a past-his-prime wedding singer, meets fading boy-band star Danny during a gig, the two bond over music and a late-night jam session. But when Danny turns one of Rick's songs into the hit that reignites his career, Rick sets out to reclaim the recognition he believes he deserves, even if it means risking everything he cares about.

starzwest.us.title: Oscar Shaw
starzwest.us.description: Haunted by the tragic loss of his closest friend, a retired detective embarks on a perilous quest for vengeance as he fights to restore justice to the streets he once protected.

starzwest.us.title: Jurassic World
starzwest.us.description: Located off the coast of Costa Rica, the Jurassic World luxury resort provides a habitat for an array of genetically engineered dinosaurs, including the vicious and intelligent Indominus rex. When the massive creature escapes, it sets off a chain reaction that causes the other dinos to run amok. Now, it's up to a former military man and animal expert to use his special skills to save two young brothers and the rest of the tourists from an all-out, prehistoric assault.

starzwest.us.title: Alarum
starzwest.us.description: Living off the grid while vacationing at a winter resort, married spies Joe and Lara come under fire from members of the old guard who suspect they've joined an elite team of rogue spies.

starzwest.us.title: Fifty Shades of Grey (Extended Version)
starzwest.us.description: When college senior Anastasia Steele (Dakota Johnson) steps in for her sick roommate to interview prominent businessman Christian Grey (Jamie Dornan) for their campus paper, little does she realize the path her life will take. Christian, as enigmatic as he is rich and powerful, finds himself strangely drawn to Ana, and she to him. Though sexually inexperienced, Ana plunges headlong into an affair -- and learns that Christian's true sexual proclivities push the boundaries of pain and pleasure.

starzwest.us.title: Enough
starzwest.us.description: Working-class waitress Slim (Jennifer Lopez) finds her life transformed when she marries wealthy contractor Mitch (Billy Campbell). She settles into an idyllic suburban life and seems to have everything she wants. Her dream is shattered when she discovers her husband is anything but perfect. His abusive behavior forces her to go on the run, eluding an increasingly obsessive Mitch and his lethal henchman.

starzwest.us.title: Pain & Gain
starzwest.us.description: Danny Lupo (Mark Wahlberg), manager of the Sun Gym in the 1990s Miami, decides that there is only one way to achieve his version of the American dream: extortion. To achieve his goal, he recruits musclemen Paul (Dwayne Johnson) and Adrian (Anthony Mackie) as accomplices. After several failed attempts, they abduct rich businessman Victor Kershaw (Tony Shalhoub) and convince him to sign over all his assets to them. But when Kershaw makes it out alive, authorities are reluctant to believe his story.

syfy.us.title: Die Hard 2
syfy.us.description: A year after his heroics in L.A., detective John McClane (Bruce Willis) is mixed up in another terrorist plot, this time at Washington Dulles International Airport, where he is waiting for his wife (Bonnie Bedelia). That same night, South American politico and drug profiteer Ramon Esperanza (Franco Nero) is arriving in U.S. custody. McClane takes action when a treasonous ex-colonel (William Sadler) seizes control of the airport, threatening to crash every inbound flight unless Esperanza is freed.

syfy.us.title: Die Hard With a Vengeance
syfy.us.description: Detective John McClane (Bruce Willis) is now divorced, alcoholic and jobless after getting fired for his reckless behavior and bad attitude. He is called back into action, however, when a cryptic terrorist (Jeremy Irons) takes New York City hostage in a lethal game of "Simon Says" and refuses to speak with anyone but McClane. Teaming up with a street-savvy electrician named Zeus Carver (Samuel L. Jackson), McClane dashes through the city, trying to stay one step ahead of a murderous plot.

syfy.us.title: Live Free or Die Hard
syfy.us.description: As the nation prepares to celebrate Independence Day, veteran cop John McClane carries out another routine assignment: bringing in a computer hacker for questioning. Meanwhile, a tech-savvy villain named Thomas Gabriel launches an attack on America's computer infrastructure. As chaos descends around him, McClane must use old-fashioned methods to fight the high-tech threat.

syfy.us.title: Safety Not Guaranteed
syfy.us.description: A disaffected magazine intern (Aubrey Plaza) befriends an unusual guy (Mark Duplass), who is looking for a partner to accompany him on a trip back through time.

syfy.us.title: The Twilight Zone - Shadow Play
syfy.us.description: A condemned man tries to convince the people around him that everything and everyone is merely part of a recurring nightmare that always ends in his execution.

syfy.us.title: The Twilight Zone - The Incredible World of Horace Ford
syfy.us.description: A toy designer (Pat Hingle) visits his old neighborhood and finds it exactly as it was in his childhood.

syfy.us.title: Silent House
syfy.us.description: Sarah (Elizabeth Olsen) is working with her father (Adam Trese) and uncle (Eric Sheffer Stevens) to renovate an old family home to prepare it for sale. Long vacant, the house has no utilities, forcing the trio to rely on battery-operated lanterns to light their way. Sarah becomes separated from her relatives and soon finds she is trapped inside the cabin, with no contact with the outside world. Panic turns to real terror as the young woman experiences events that become increasingly ominous.

syfy.us.title: Halloween II
syfy.us.description: A year after narrowly escaping death at the hands of Michael Myers (Tyler Mane), Laurie Strode is at the breaking point, pushed to the edge by Dr. Loomis' (Malcolm McDowell) revelation that she's Michael's sister. Little does she know, the unstoppable killer is back in Haddonfield and, driven by visions of their dead mother (Sheri Moon Zombie), he is determined to bring about a bloody family reunion.

syfywest.us.title: Die Hard

He joins her at a holiday party in the headquarters of the Japanese-owned business she works for. But the festivities are interrupted by a group of terrorists who take over the exclusive high-rise, and everyone in it. Very soon McClane realizes that there's no one to save the hostages -- but him.

talkingpictures.uk.title: An Innocent Man (1989)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A mechanic accused of a crime he didn't commit is sent to serve time with a gang of hardened criminals. By befriending a tough but influential inmate he manages to get parole, but still finds himself hounded on the outside by the bent cops that framed him. In a bid to be rid of them once and for all, he enlists the help of his underworld contacts to devise a plan that will lure the officers into a fatal blunder.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Crown Court - Public Lives - Part 1
talkingpictures.uk.description: A theatre production company is charged with breaching obscenity laws following the performance of a play called 'Public Lives' at the Fulchester Palace Theatre. The performance, which included nudity and sex acts, led to dozens of complaints.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Crown Court - Public Lives - Part 2
talkingpictures.uk.description: Actress Mandy Jenkins tells how she was sacked from 'Public Lives' when she claimed the play became obscene. Author EW Appleby states he had his name removed from the credits, after the dress rehearsal, when the actors performed nude.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Crown Court - Public Lives - Part 3

talkingpictures.uk.description: A magazine editor has an affair with the wife of a recently deceased publisher and winds up a prime murder suspect.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Call Northside 777 (1948)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Tense documentary-style thriller based on a true-life case, about a Chicago newspaper reporter who doggedly sets out to prove jailed Richard Conte is innocent of murder.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Look at Life - Birdmen
talkingpictures.uk.description: A look at the origins of man-powered flight, focusing on John Wimpenny, the first man to pedal himself through the air for more than half a mile. Also featuring a look at today's attempts.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Weir's Way - Fast Castle to St Abb's Head
talkingpictures.uk.description: In this episode, Tom takes the 5-mile trek from the remarkable Fast Castle, built on crags and reckoned to have been built for shipwrecking to the popular summer destination of St Abbs.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Brothers - A Bad Mistake
talkingpictures.uk.description: Ann fears losing everything. Meanwhile, Edward meets prospective shareholders, but his honesty causes a setback. (Drama) - 1974

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals - Not Your Nonna's Risotto
tastemade.us.description: Jamie makes a low-cost dosa, crispy chicken, oozy barley risotto, beef stew and shortbread biscuits.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals - Easy Chicken Curry and Feta Tomato Pasta
tastemade.us.description: Jamie makes an air-fryer tomato and roast feta pasta using leftover noodles, a budget rolled carrot cake, and a cheap family chicken curry. Plus, an epic cheese-on-toast Welsh rarebit upgrade and frozen fish Chinese-inspired dough parcels!

tastemade.us.title: Thanksgiving HOT TAKE: Is Turkey actually the worst? - Forking Delicious: Top 10 Thanksgiving Dishes
tastemade.us.description: On this episode, we're talking turkey. That's right, it's time for Thanksgiving! Join our panel of thankful experts as they gather to offer their insights and opinions as we count down your top ten turkey day must-haves.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Thanksgiving Dinner
tastemade.us.description: Thanksgiving dinner will be a breeze this year thanks to Frankie's struggle tips for a delicious holiday meal. From a simple turkey entrée to a new twist on a classic dessert, Frankie makes a feast without unstuffing his wallet.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Thanksgiving Leftovers
tastemade.us.description: SeriesTMSID: SH030064860000. Series Description: The struggle is real, but it doesn't mean your food has to suffer. Chef Frankie Celenza shows you how to make delicious meals that won't break the bank.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Grubby Good Food
tastemade.us.description: Send your taste buds on a first class food tour without even leaving the Struggle kitchen! Frankie whips up his favorite regional specialties from five destinations, making them as authentic as possible while sticking to his budget.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Meals Under $7
tastemade.us.description: At a loss when your pantry is empty? With these recipes, you can walk into any grocery store with only $7 and walk out with everything you need for an entire meal. Because yes, you can whip up a nutritious meal at an affordable price!

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Frankie's Italian Faves
tastemade.us.description: Frankie goes back to his roots with these Italian recipes that even his Nonno would love.

tastemade.us.title: Thanksgiving HOT TAKE: Is Turkey actually the worst? - Forking Delicious: Top 10 Thanksgiving Dishes
tastemade.us.description: On this episode, we're talking turkey. That's right, it's time for Thanksgiving! Join our panel of thankful experts as they gather to offer their insights and opinions as we count down your top ten turkey day must-haves.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Thanksgiving Dinner
tastemade.us.description: Thanksgiving dinner will be a breeze this year thanks to Frankie's struggle tips for a delicious holiday meal. From a simple turkey entrée to a new twist on a classic dessert, Frankie makes a feast without unstuffing his wallet.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Thanksgiving Leftovers
tastemade.us.description: SeriesTMSID: SH030064860000. Series Description: The struggle is real, but it doesn't mean your food has to suffer. Chef Frankie Celenza shows you how to make delicious meals that won't break the bank.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Grubby Good Food
tastemade.us.description: Send your taste buds on a first class food tour without even leaving the Struggle kitchen! Frankie whips up his favorite regional specialties from five destinations, making them as authentic as possible while sticking to his budget.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Spice Spice Baby
tastemade.us.description: Frankie kicks it up a notch in the Struggle Kitchen with flavor-packed, spicy recipes, and some hot tips for adding layers of flavor. But don't sweat it, these warming dishes won't burn your cash or your taste buds.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - But First, Brunch
tastemade.us.description: Bring your loved ones together over a delicious brunch spread made with love. Whether you're celebrating a major milestone or simply toasting to the weekend, Frankie's money-saving menu will have guests buzzing for more.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - French Bistro
tastemade.us.description: Bonsoir, indeed! Join Frankie as he cooks up elegant but achievable French classics that will transport you to an evening on the Seine, complete with some savvy wine tips without the hefty cost of a plane ticket.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Struggle Splurge
tastemade.us.description: The key to treating yourself on a budget is to keep it simple: these elegant dinners taste like restaurant specials, but they can be prepared in under one hour - perfect for easy weeknight meals for a family of any size on a busy schedule.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Eat Your Greens
tastemade.us.description: Going green isn't just a trend; it's a no-brainer! When the veggies are in season and the prices are at their lowest, Frankie's colorful recipes and zero waste tips will have you celebrating the savings with fresh spring produce.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - We Knead Pizza
tastemade.us.description: Cancel the pizza delivery, it's time to save money and build your pies from scratch. With three different pizza styles, you're bound to find one that satisfies your craving without digging into your wallet.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Homemade-ish
tastemade.us.description: Last minute company leaving you in a pinch? Frankie has you covered with these easy recipes featuring store bought staples. With a few Struggle tips, these basic ingredients can be transformed into dishes that will impress your guests.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Pizza My Heart
tastemade.us.description: On this special delivery episode of Struggle Meals, Frankie explores three ways to make delicious pizzas, and shares clever tips to make an A+ pie without dropping your dough on expensive ingredients.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Whole Chicken 101
tastemade.us.description: Join Frankie to learn the ins and outs of using every part of a chicken, as he demonstrates how to maximize the value and minimize waste. By cooking smarter, you'll have three delectable recipes to last you the whole week.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Picnic Lunches
tastemade.us.description: It's field trip day, and Frankie shows off his best handheld lunches perfect for leisurely days at the park, the beach or the pool. These sturdy meals are made to travel and only get better with time.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Saved By The Bowl
tastemade.us.description: When you're craving a quick nutritious meal, say no more to throwing cash down the gutter for overpriced takeout bowls! Frankie recreates three restaurant favorites for a fraction of the cost, sparing your bank account without sacrificing flavor.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Meatless Mains
tastemade.us.description: Start a new tradition at the dinner table this year with a meat free spin on your favorite main courses. Learn new tips and tricks to make your veggie forward dinner so delightful that even the biggest meat eaters will be back for seconds.

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - The Wonderful World of Pizza
tastemade.us.description: Frankie makes pizza magic with two incredible doughs, turning his kitchen into a pizza party with grilled sausage pizza, cheesy Grandma Pies, golden Panzerotti, and a sweet dessert pizza topped with ricotta, berries, and honey.

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Lunch That Goes the Distance
tastemade.us.description: Frankie fuels up for action making hot Oatmeal, and Energy Date Balls, before he cooks up the perfect post-ride feast of cheesy Juicy Lucy Burgers, Ramp-loaded pasta salad, and a maple ginger switchel to cool it all down.

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Pasta From Scratch
tastemade.us.description: Frankie explores his Italian roots, pairing each pasta shape with its perfect sauce-from Cavatelli with Super Green Sauce to Pappardelle in pork ragout, ricotta Gnocchi with punchy anchovy pecorino, and cozy Squash Orzotto with bloomed poppy seeds.

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Italian Smokehouse
tastemade.us.description: Frankie fires up a steakhouse-style spread with Italian flair from golden beets and buttery mushrooms to a sizzling Bistecca alla Fiorentina steak with salmoriglio sauce, and a smooth cold brew affogato granita.

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Frankie's Feast of the Seven Fishes
tastemade.us.description: Frankie reimagines the Feast of the Seven Fishes with a shellfish-free spread making Smoked Whitefish Salad, Anchovy Butter Toast, Salt-baked Red Snapper, Trout Scapece, and Pasta con le Sarde, with a helping hand from his mom.

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Thanksgiving Spatchcock & Sides
tastemade.us.description: Frankie skips the stress and roasts a juicy spatchcocked turkey, then goes big on sides-cardamom rolls, Sweet & Savory Dauphinoise Potatoes, Brussels Sprouts with Bacon Jam, and a bright Citrus Salad with smoked salt.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Crispy Pork Noodles and Cheesy Chard Cannelloni
tastemade.us.description: Jamie celebrates rhubarb in a lip-smacking sauce, heroes spinach in a silky goat's cheese risotto and marries vibrant basil with chard in a crowd-pleasing cheesy spring cannelloni.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Spring Onion Chicken Curry and Sausage Broccoli Pizza
tastemade.us.description: Jamie elevates asparagus spears for a fishy feat, makes spring onions the star of the show in his spicy green chicken curry and gives purple sprouting broccoli an Italian-inspired makeover.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E09 Outdoor Kitchen Marlow, Phil, their 3 small kids, and Phil's parents all live in one crowded house. Brian and Sarah transform their yard into a spectacular space for cooking, entertaining and playing.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E07 Luxury Staycation Since having two kids, Sonia and Peter have resorted to staycations at home, but their backyard is a headache. Brian and Sarah create a luxury vacation destination that includes a pool, spa, outdoor kitchen and a stunning four-season structure.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E09 Social Central Sunroom Sonia & Paul are big social connectors in their community with a constant flow of visitors. Brian and Sarah turn their barren backyard into a social hotspot, complete with sunroom, giant chessboard, waterfall and stylish outdoor entertainment spaces.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E04 Stained Glass Studio Couple Farzana & Reyan have maxed out all living space in their city-sized bungalow, leaving no room for Reyan's at-home stained-glass business or Farzana's writing. Brian and Sarah build Reyan a spacious studio and construct an inspiring deck area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E06 Creative Lounge Dave and Jorge love art and entertaining, but with tenants in their basement and no creative space inside, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into a creative party lounge and build a shipping container-inspired structure for an industrial feel.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E03 Cozy Leather Cabin Workshop Brian and Sarah create a backyard for Pam & Kevin that matches their lush forest surrounding complete with a double wrap around deck and a hot tub. The team also build a workshop for Kevin to perfect his craft of leather tooling.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E02 Nana's Wonderland Janet's love for her nine grandkids is endless. But so is the chaos they bring inside her home when they come visit. To take that energy outside, Brian and Sarah build a fun kid-zone in the backyard, but also a sophisticated adult area for Janet.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 Twins Clubhouse Sham, Ruban and their twin boys aren't using their big, boring backyard. To help this family embrace the great outdoors, Brian and Sarah build a vacation style getaway, with a beach volleyball court and a kid's clubhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E06 His and Hers Hideaway Miriam and Mark are busy parents to four kids under 10 years old. To help these hardworking parents unwind, Brian and Sarah build them a parents-only hideaway in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E01 A Space For Dancing and Hanging Susan's energetic son, Harrison, has no space to dance at home without getting under his mom's feet. Brian and Sarah build a hang-out / dance space for Harrison and create a California-inspired pool and lounge area for Susan.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E07 Plunge Pool Paradise Aarati & Dave both work from home, forcing their living room to be a triple duty working/living/children's play area. Brian and Sarah create a flexible structure, install a sleek and sophisticated plunge pool, and create an outdoor fireplace lounge.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E05 Wellness Wonderland Breanna & Nick's life revolves around socializing and physical activity. Brian and Sarah convert an old, underused shed into a beautiful, zen'd out yoga studio and create backyard partying, lounging and dining areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E07 Outdoor Amphitheater Jon, Trish, and their two children live in a quintessential family-friendly neighborhood. To give the whole community an outdoor space to enjoy, Brian and Sarah build an outdoor movie theater in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E07 Mom's Retreat Melissa and Lee's 3 boys need more room for sports, and Mom needs more peace and quiet! So Brian and Sarah turn the underused backyard into a sports court, a new lounge space, and a luxurious, 3-season Mom's retreat.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E04 Country Supper Club & Coop Ex-city slickers, Lauren and Mark, miss their friends and family from the city. Brian and Sarah create a country retreat with an outdoor pad, indoor dining lounge, and a chicken coop. When Lauren and Mark's friends visit, they'll never want to leave.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E05 Farm to Table Andrea and David are foodies, but hosting in their "builder basic" yard is no fun. Brian and Sarah make their farm-to-table dreams come true, with a veggie garden, dining room, BBQ zone, and a play space for their 2 kids.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E08 D.J.'s Den Cool parents, Michelle and Adrian, are passionate about music and events. Brian and Sarah tune into their needs and amp up their boring backyard with a DJ den, a creative arts-and-crafts wall, and hang-out zones for family jam sessions.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 Sports Bar Craig and Claudia share their new space with Craig's brother, Craig's parents - and their two massive dogs. To give these new homeowners a place of their own, Brian and Sarah build a sports bar and entertainment hangout in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Pub Paradise Bachelor Kyle's father Jack has helped him renovate his new home, but the backyard is still unusable. To help Kyle throw the ultimate housewarming party, Brian and Sarah build a sexy sports pub, a lounge area and a fire pit.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E01 Inspiring Cake Studio Tina and her husband Patrick have a home that is overrun with both baking supplies and soccer equipment. To extend this family's living space, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into one part cake decorating studio and one part soccer field.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E11 Multipurpose Cabana Brian and Sarah build a sun deck, outdoor dining area and a Grecian inspired, 3-season garage conversion.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E14 Modern Woodshop Newlyweds Cheryl and Gavin love their new home, but Cheryl doesn't love the sound of Gavin's woodworking in the garage. Brian and Sarah help by building a dedicated wood shop and some chic new living space in their urban backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Creative Shipping Container Kirsten works from the home office, while Joel is a sales representative with a make-shift workspace in their bedroom. To help this couple, Brian and Sarah look to the backyard for space to retrofit an old shipping container into an office.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E13 Hillside Playhouse Matt, Mary and their 2 kids don't use their backyard because the neighboring ravine has taken over. Brian and Sarah face environmental challenges to create a beautiful, entertaining and play space for the whole family to enjoy.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Brokeback Mountain
tastemadetravel.us.description: After four weeks on the road, Gino's airing his feet in the back seat as the guys cruise along a Texan highway. Texas is a meat lover's paradise, and Gordon is keen to show the Europhiles some of the best BBQ known to man.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The French Connection
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Highland Fling
tastemadetravel.us.description: The trio heads to Scotland as Gordon prepares to cook a feast for the chief of Clan Ramsay and his friends. Gordon shows the others how to dress like real Scotsmen as they go in search of Scottish beef, hunt for scallops and play some Highland Games.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Go Greek! Clash of the Titans
tastemadetravel.us.description: The boys are in the Greek capital Athens in a vintage VW campervan. This is where high-concept cuisine originated and is still being re-invented, in a city known as the birthplace of democracy and the cradle of western civilisation.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Desperately Seeking Santa
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred are getting together for another extraordinary culinary Christmas adventure. Gordon arranged a trip to the official home of Santa. They are going to Lapland to enjoy spectacular landscapes and meet Father Christmas in person.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Three Amigos
tastemadetravel.us.description: On a mission to taste the world's best breakfast, the three big egos Gordon, Gino and Fred are venturing out of their comfort zones crossing over the USA border into Mexico. They hope to stay out of trouble as they drive their bad boy transporter.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - What Happens in Vegas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon wants to show Fred & Gino that the food and fresh produce are off the charts! In Las Vegas they indulge in one of the most expensive beef burgers. After a night at the casino they're on the road again to experience the real wild west.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - San Fran Summer of Love
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gino & Fred are excited to head to San Francisco for their very own Summer of Love. Gordon tries to embrace the flower power mood, but he's more interested in the 61 Michelin Stars. The boys travel to a Napa Valley vineyard in a hot air balloon.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Brokeback Mountain
tastemadetravel.us.description: After four weeks on the road, Gino's airing his feet in the back seat as the guys cruise along a Texan highway. Texas is a meat lover's paradise, and Gordon is keen to show the Europhiles some of the best BBQ known to man.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Italian Job
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The French Connection
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland.

tbs.us.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Donation Oscillation
tbs.us.description: Penny tries to throw a wrench into Leonard's plan to be a sperm donor for her ex-boyfriend; Wolowitz, Bernadette, Anu and Koothrappali turn Koothrappali's canceled bachelor party into a couple's trip aboard the "vomit comet."

tbs.us.title: The Big Bang Theory - The D & D Vortex
tbs.us.description: The gang uses deception and betrayal to make it to the one open seat at Wil Wheaton's celebrity Dungeons and Dragons game with William Shatner, Joe Manganiello, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar and Kevin Smith.

tbs.us.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Conference Valuation
tbs.us.description: When Penny and Bernadette go to San Diego for a pharmaceutical sales convention, Wolowitz is left in charge of the kids; Sheldon finds a book about experimenting on kids.

tbs.us.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Laureate Accumulation
tbs.us.description: When competitors Pemberton and Campbell charm America on a publicity tour, Sheldon and Amy try to win over Nobel laureates Kip Thorne, George Smoot and Frances Arnold; Halley's fear of the dark leads to opportunity and conflict.

tbs.us.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Inspiration Deprivation
tbs.us.description: The weight of winning a Nobel Prize weighs heavy on Amy's shoulders; Koothrappali and Wolowitz try to relive the good old days after Wolowitz buys a scooter that looks like the one he had years ago.

tbs.us.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Decision Reverberation
tbs.us.description: Koothrappali is worried people won't take him seriously in his own field after publishing a paper that suggests he may have discovered alien life; Leonard wants to be the principal investigator on a plasma physics study.

tbs.us.title: All Elite Wrestling: Dynamite ᴺᵉʷ
tbs.us.description: All Elite Wrestling continues to inject new spirit, freshness and energy into mainstream wrestling featuring a world-class roster of diverse male and female wrestlers.

tbs.us.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
tbs.us.description: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world.

tbs.us.title: The Office - Garage Sale
tbs.us.description: Michael decides to ask Holly to marry him; the office has a garage sale.

tbs.us.title: The Office - Training Day
tbs.us.description: Everyone hopes to make good first impressions with the new manager, Deangelo Vickers.

tbs.us.title: The Office - Michael's Last Dundies
tbs.us.description: Michael teaches DeAngelo (Will Ferrell) how to host the Dundie Awards; Erin struggles with her feelings for Gabe.

tbs.us.title: The Office - Goodbye Michael, Part 1
tbs.us.description: Michael wants a drama-free day to say goodbye to his friends; Deangelo and Andy work to keep Michael's most-important clients.

tbs.us.title: The Office - Goodbye Michael, Part 2
tbs.us.description: Michael wants a drama-free day to say goodbye to his friends; Deangelo and Andy work to keep Michael's most-important clients.

tbs.us.title: The Office - Inner Circle
tbs.us.description: Deangelo plays favorites by creating an inner circle of most liked employees, and the women notice it seems to be all guys.

tbs.us.title: The Office - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager
tbs.us.description: Dwight uses his position as acting manager to employ harsh policies in the office; Gabe tries to get Erin back.

tbs.us.title: The Office - Search Committee
tbs.us.description: Jim heads a team that interviews applicants, including several co-workers; Dwight tries to reassert himself as a contender.

tbs.us.title: The Office - Search Committee
tbs.us.description: Jim heads a team that interviews applicants, including several co-workers; Dwight tries to reassert himself as a contender.

tbs.us.title: American Dad! - There Will Be Bad Blood
tbs.us.description: Stan invites his half-brother, Rusty (Lou Diamond Phillips), over for Thanksgiving, then gets upset when he learns how wealthy Rusty is.

tbs.us.title: American Dad! - Kung Pao Turkey
tbs.us.description: Francine invites her adoptive parents to Thanksgiving dinner, ruining Stan's plans to watch football.

tbs.us.title: Friends - The One Where Ross Is Fine
tbs.us.description: Ross drinks too much alcohol at dinner with Rachel, Joey and Charlie; Frank Jr. (Giovanni Ribisi) cannot cope with his precocious triplets.

tbs.us.title: Friends - The One With Ross's Tan
tbs.us.description: Rachel and Joey nervously anticipate their first real date; Monica and Phoebe try to avoid an obnoxious friend with a fake British accent; Ross emerges from a tanning booth with a two-toned appearance.

tbs.us.title: Friends - The One With the Cake
tbs.us.description: Rachel gets Monica and Chandler to delay their trip to Vermont for Emma's first birthday bash.

tbs.us.title: Friends - The One Where Rachel's Sister Baby-Sits
tbs.us.description: Rachel feels like her younger sister, Amy, is finally on the verge of making a major change in her attitude; in order to help Amy become a more responsible person, Rachel overrides Ross' strong protests and allows Amy to baby-sit Emma.

tbs.us.title: Friends - The One With Ross's Grant
tbs.us.description: When Ross interviews with Charlie's ex-boyfriend (Greg Kinnear) for a prized grant, the doctor makes a shocking stipulation; Chandler lies about watching Joey's bizarre audition tape.

tbs.us.title: Friends - The One With the Home Study
tbs.us.description: Monica and Chandler fuss over their apartment as they expect a visit from the adoption worker, Laura; Phoebe and Mike opt for a small wedding and donate the extra money to a children's charity.

tbs.us.title: Friends - The One With the Late Thanksgiving
tbs.us.description: Monica prepares a Thanksgiving feast for the gang, then becomes enraged when everyone shows up late; Phoebe convinces Rachel to enter Emma in a baby beauty contest.

tbs.us.title: Friends - The One With the Birth Mother
tbs.us.description: A prospective birth mother (Anna Faris) labors under a misconception about Monica and Chandler's respective occupations.

tbs.us.title: Friends - The One Where Chandler Gets Caught
tbs.us.description: Rachel and Phoebe spot Chandler getting into a car with a mystery blonde; the friends reminisce about memorable moments.

tbs.us.title: Friends - The One Where the Stripper Cries
tbs.us.description: Joey appears as a celebrity contestant on "$100,000 Pyramid"; Monica and Rachel hire an ungainly stripper for Phoebe's bachelorette party.

tbs.us.title: Friends - The One With Phoebe's Wedding
tbs.us.description: A blizzard causes Phoebe and Mike's wedding to spiral out of control; uptight Monica steps in as her friend's wedding planner, then drives everyone crazy.

tbs.us.title: Friends - The One Where Joey Speaks French
tbs.us.description: Monica and Chandler show Erica the tourist sights; they learn their baby's biological father might be an unsavory character; Joey begs Phoebe to teach him how to speak French before an audition.

tbs.us.title: Friends - The One With Princess Consuela
tbs.us.description: Rachel goes to a job interview at a restaurant and winds up sitting next to her current boss; Joey feels abandoned because Monica and Chandler are leaving.

tbs.us.title: Friends - The One Where Underdog Gets Away
tbs.us.description: Monica and Ross cook Thanksgiving dinner for themselves, but everyone else shows up.

tbs.us.title: Friends - The One With the List
tbs.us.description: Rachel sees Ross' list comparing her pros and cons to Julie's (Lauren Tom).

tbs.us.title: Friends - The One With the Football
tbs.us.description: Emotions become the feast of the day when the gang plays a game of touch football on Thanksgiving; the turkey is left stewing when the losing team calls for a rematch.

tbs.us.title: Friends - The One With Chandler in a Box
tbs.us.description: To atone for kissing Joey's girlfriend, Chandler agrees to stay inside a shipping crate during the Thanksgiving holiday. (Sitcom) - 1997-11-20

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Loud House Thanksgiving Special

themoviechannel.us.title: Faster
themoviechannel.us.description: Following a 10-year prison stint, Driver (Dwayne Johnson) sprints through the gates to take vengeance on those responsible for his brother's murder. Within hours of dispatching his first one, he has two men on his tail: a veteran police officer (Billy Bob Thornton) and an eager assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). Driver tries to stay a step ahead of his pursuers, but there are hints that his list is incomplete, and the unknown person may endanger his life.

themoviechannel.us.title: Every Breath You Take
themoviechannel.us.description: A psychiatrist's life gets turned upside down when a patient takes her own life, and he introduces her brother to his own family.

themoviechannel.us.title: Gone Baby Gone
themoviechannel.us.description: Along with his girlfriend (Michelle Monaghan), a private detective (Casey Affleck) takes on the difficult task of searching for a kidnapped girl in Boston. During his investigation, he must deal with the girl's aunt, a disapproving lawman (Morgan Freeman) and a drug dealer.

themoviechannel.us.title: Along Came a Spider
themoviechannel.us.description: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case.

themoviechannel.us.title: Primal Fear
themoviechannel.us.description: Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect.

themoviechannel.us.title: Fatal Attraction
themoviechannel.us.description: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family.

themoviechannel.us.title: Smoke Signals
themoviechannel.us.description: Arnold (Gary Farmer) rescued Thomas (Evan Adams) from a fire when he was a child. Thomas thinks of Arnold as a hero, while Arnold's son Victor (Adam Beach) resents his father's alcoholism, violence and abandonment of his family. Uneasy rivals and friends, Thomas and Victor spend their days killing time on a Coeur d'Alene reservation in Idaho and arguing about their cultural identities. When Arnold dies, the duo set out on a cross-country journey to Phoenix to retrieve Arnold's ashes.

tnt.us.title: Fred Claus
tnt.us.description: Of the two Claus brothers, Fred is the troublemaker and polar opposite of his saintly sibling, Nicholas. When Fred's criminal ways finally land him in trouble, Nicholas bails him out and brings him to the North Pole to work off the debt by making toys. The headaches mount for St. Nick, who must not only deal with his troublemaking brother, but also an efficiency expert, who has come to evaluate Santa's operation.

tnt.us.title: NHL Hockey - Carolina Hurricanes at Tampa Bay Lightning ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
tnt.us.description: The Lightning host the Hurricanes in NHL regular-season play at Benchmark International Arena. Carolina have won the last two meetings between these Eastern Conference rivals, including a 4-2 victory at this venue in March.

tnt.us.title: NHL Post-Game on TNT ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
tnt.us.description: Liam McHugh, Anson Carter and Paul Bissonnette recap the night in the NHL.

tnt.us.description: Of the two Claus brothers, Fred is the troublemaker and polar opposite of his saintly sibling, Nicholas. tnt.us.title: FBI - Compromised
tnt.us.description: After a key witness and a U.S. marshal are ambushed and killed, Maggie and OA must find the man who leaked the information that led to their murders.

tnt.us.title: FBI - The Armorer's Faith
tnt.us.description: When an illegal arms broker-turned-informant is assassinated, OA assumes his identity and goes undercover to stop the sale of dangerous weapons, with help from Maggie and their former FBI instructor.

tnt.us.title: FBI - Identity Crisis
tnt.us.description: When a judge and her daughter are murdered after she sentences a man to life in prison, Maggie and OA search for the killer; Dana has a history with the victim and a vested interest in the case.

tnt.us.title: FBI - A New Dawn
tnt.us.description: When an alt-right provocateur is murdered after giving a speech at a university in New York City, Maggie and OA investigate the school's more extreme political groups and rely on OA's sister, a student, for help.

tnt.us.title: FBI - Partners in Crime
tnt.us.description: Maggie and OA must find a couple that is responsible for a spree of violent armed robberies that led to the death of an off-duty police officer.

tnt.us.title: FBI - Double Bind
tnt.us.description: As the team works to rescue a 5-year-old kidnapping victim, Scola suspects the boy's mother isn't being forthcoming about why her son was targeted; Nina struggles to open up to Scola about matters in their relationship.

tnt.us.title: Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory
tnt.us.description: The last of five coveted "golden tickets" falls into the hands of a sweet but very poor boy. He and his grandpa then get a tour of the strangest chocolate factory in the world. The owner leads five young winners on a thrilling and often dangerous tour of his factory.

tnt.us.title: The Year Without a Santa Claus
tnt.us.description: Sidelined by a nasty cold and feeling unneeded, Santa decides not to make his annual Christmas journey. Elves Jingle and Jangle scour the world to find people who still believe, hoping to convince the jolly old elf to make his trip anyway. They run into trouble in Southtown, however, and the only way they can get out of their predicament is to make it snow in the warm climate. Meanwhile, Santa sees evidence that people do still believe, and a little girl's touching letter prompts him to pack up the sleigh and head out on his annual trek, making a special stop in the now-snowy Southtown.

tnt.us.title: The Polar Express
tnt.us.description: When a doubting young boy takes a train ride to the North Pole, he embarks on a journey of self-discovery that shows him that the wonder of life never fades for those who believe.

tnt.us.title: Four Christmases
tnt.us.description: When their plans for an exotic vacation fall apart, unmarried couple Brad (Vince Vaughn) and Kate (Reese Witherspoon) must spend Christmas Day trudging around to a quartet of family get-togethers. tntwest.us.description: Of the two Claus brothers, Fred is the troublemaker and polar opposite of his saintly sibling, Nicholas. The headaches mount for St. Nick, who must not only deal with his troublemaking brother, but also an efficiency expert, who has come to evaluate Santa's operation.

tntwest.us.title: Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory
tntwest.us.description: The last of five coveted "golden tickets" falls into the hands of a sweet but very poor boy. He and his grandpa then get a tour of the strangest chocolate factory in the world. The owner leads five young winners on a thrilling and often dangerous tour of his factory.

tntwest.us.title: The Year Without a Santa Claus
tntwest.us.description: Sidelined by a nasty cold and feeling unneeded, Santa decides not to make his annual Christmas journey. Elves Jingle and Jangle scour the world to find people who still believe, hoping to convince the jolly old elf to make his trip anyway. They run into trouble in Southtown, however, and the only way they can get out of their predicament is to make it snow in the warm climate. Meanwhile, Santa sees evidence that people do still believe, and a little girl's touching letter prompts him to pack up the sleigh and head out on his annual trek, making a special stop in the now-snowy Southtown.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - The Great King - Images and Realities
truehistory.us.description: Seeing beyond the outside stereotypes of Persian kings as tyrants; seeing what the kings themselves have to say; in sculpted reliefs and carvings on royal tombs, the words and images of Darius and Xerxes show Persian values of harmonious cooperation.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - Royal Roads and Provinces
truehistory.us.description: A trip into the western provinces; the empire's diverse local customs; the Persian Empire is famous for its roads and bridges; how its express messenger system allows information to travel quickly; the king keeps tabs on every corner of the empire.

truehistory.us.title: The Other Side of History: Daily Life in the Ancient World - Taking On the Other Side of History
truehistory.us.description: The past comes alive when considering the imaginary lives of ordinary people; these include the citizens, soldiers and slaves who live on the other side of history; asking questions that many textbooks never ask.

truehistory.us.title: The Other Side of History: Daily Life in the Ancient World - Being Paleolithic
truehistory.us.description: Taking a look at the lives of human ancestors; picturing oneself as a Neanderthal, whose life is dominated by the environment; discovering the significance of the human mind, language and art in the Old Stone Age.

truehistory.us.title: The Other Side of History: Daily Life in the Ancient World - Living in Mesopotamia
truehistory.us.description: Stepping into the world's earliest permanent settlement; why the development of agriculture is a revolution; the invention of writing; the creation of laws; an increase in trade; technological innovations such as the wheel.

truehistory.us.title: The Other Side of History: Daily Life in the Ancient World - Being Egyptian
truehistory.us.description: What it is like to be an ancient Egyptian; exploring everyday life during the New Kingdom era; the richness of the Nile; the conservatism and stability of the society; relics that survive across millennia, such as hieroglyphics, papyri and art.

truehistory.us.title: Foundations of Western Civilization II: A History of the Modern Western World - The Importance of the West
truehistory.us.description: An overview of the past 500 years of European history and culture; the system of government; economic structures; science and technology; the literature, art and music.

truehistory.us.title: Foundations of Western Civilization II: A History of the Modern Western World - Geography Is Destiny
truehistory.us.description: How the physical realities of Europe and the Atlantic world shaped its destiny; geography and climate affecting patterns of population, immigration, diplomacy, war, and political and cultural divisions.

truehistory.us.title: Foundations of Western Civilization II: A History of the Modern Western World - Culture Is Destiny
truehistory.us.description: The Great Chain of Being, which assumed an ordered, hierarchical universe in which humans were placed in a particular rank by God; Europe emerging from the Middle Ages; how the concept was challenged and strained by various forces.

truehistory.us.title: Foundations of Western Civilization II: A History of the Modern Western World - Renaissance Humanism - 1350 - 1650
truehistory.us.description: A revived interest in the literary and historical works of classical Greece and Rome; new ideas about the qualifications of a gentleman, the role of women and the expectations of a prince; a resulting emphasis on literacy and education.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - Rethinking the Persian Empire
truehistory.us.description: Cyrus, Darius and Xerxes; these Persian kings are sometimes stereotyped as one-dimensional despots in Greek histories; the truth about the Achaemenid Persian Empire; an empire that stretches from Egypt and Asia Minor, all the way to the Indus Valley.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - Questioning the Sources
truehistory.us.description: Greek historians provide valuable information about the Persian Empire; the Greek perspective is often negatively biased; archaeology uncovers inscriptions, administrative tablets and other documents that let the Persians speak for themselves.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - The World before Cyrus
truehistory.us.description: The ancient world before the Persian Empire; in the centuries leading up to the Persian Empire, the Assyrians are the major international power; the Assyrian kingdom collapses; it leaves a power vacuum in the region; the stage set for new power.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - Cyrus and Cambyses - Founders of the Empire
truehistory.us.description: Cyrus, the first great king of the Persian Empire, expands the empire through pragmatic leadership; he uses local customs and traditions and thereby gains legitimacy over Central Asia and Babylon; his son Cambyses expands the empire into Egypt.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - Darius I - Creator of the Imperial System
truehistory.us.description: Whether Darius, the son-in-law of Cyrus, is a legitimate king; After Cambyses dies, Darius establishes himself as an unwavering leader; Darius creates a royal genealogy and a Persian identity; he then turns to building infrastructure.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - Persian Capitals and Royal Palaces
truehistory.us.description: The five Persian capitals; Pasargadae, Ecbatana, Babylon, Susa and Persepolis; built in strategic, fortified locations, these cities are major symbols of power for the great kings; exploring the great hall at Persepolis, which holds 10,000 guests.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Rubbed the Wrong Way

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Flatfoot the Pirate
