trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Remember the Pact
trutv.us.description: Murr, Sal, Joe and Q beg shoppers to hold on to a weird item and then teach tech to seniors; the loser reveals his embarrassing digital life to his dad.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Silence of the Lame
trutv.us.description: The guys square off in a toy-pitching competition; the big loser must quiet down patrons in a food court.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - The Walking Dread
trutv.us.description: Joe, Murr, Sal and Q take time to smell the roses while strangers wonder what stinks; the guys pair up to double-dip; the loser goes underground to save his family but ends up battling an undead enemy.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Take Me Out at the Ballgame
trutv.us.description: Q, Murr, Joe and Sal get drenched at a water park, and play a wild round of TP basketball at a grocery store; the loser strikes out while jockeying for a ball from New York Mets pitcher Noah Syndergaard.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - The Party Crasher
trutv.us.description: Joe, Sal, Q and Murr dodge shakedowns with the help of some strangers and then get handsy in a parking lot; a clip bait battle takes place in the park and the loser has a run-in at a party.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Dover and Out
trutv.us.description: Sal, Murr, Joe and Q survey employees with odd questions; tonight's loser unveils a mural in a small town whose residents react with big-city rage.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - The Marathon Man
trutv.us.description: Sal, Murr, Q and Joe climb to the Top of the Rock for some awkward interactions, then "whet" their appetites at a bagel shop; the evening's loser takes a run across the Brooklyn Bridge that is anything but inspiring.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Guilty as Charged
trutv.us.description: Murr, Sal, Joe, and Q enlist shoppers to help them avoid a rogue security guard; the big loser faces the wrath of a crowd of rockers.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - No Good Deed
trutv.us.description: Q, Sal, Murr and Joe compete in a focus group face-off, convincing people that their TV show ideas are the best; the losers stand to get run out of town when they reveal their financial mismanagement plan to charity donors. (Reality, Comedy) - 2018-02-15

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Stripteased

trutvwest.us.description: The guys are hit with some bad reception while working behind a desk; the guys head to the park where they ask strangers for advice on their questionable life choice; tonight's big loser is tasked with taking photos of a water aerobics class.

trutvwest.us.title: Miracle
trutvwest.us.description: When college coach Herb Brooks (Kurt Russell) is hired to helm the 1980 U.S. men's Olympic hockey team, he brings a unique and brash style to the ice. After assembling a team of hot-headed college all-stars, who are humiliated in an early match, Brooks unites his squad against a common foe, the heavily-favored Soviet team. As the U.S. squad tries to overcome insurmountable odds and win the gold medal, the team becomes a microcosm for American patriotism during the Cold War.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - X Man

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Medium, Well Done

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Drum and Drummer

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: National Velvet
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When Velvet Brown (Elizabeth Taylor), an equine-loving 12-year-old living in rural Sussex, becomes the owner of a rambunctious horse, she decides to train it for England's Grand National race. Aided by former jockey Mi Taylor (Mickey Rooney) and encouraged by her family, the determined Velvet gets her steed, affectionately called "The Pie," ready for the big day. However, a last-minute problem arises with the jockey and an unexpected rider must step in as a replacement.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Fortunes of Captain Blood
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Following his banishment from England for aiding an injured enemy, physician Peter Blood (Louis Hayward) resorts to piracy, becoming captain of a notorious crew of buccaneers. Sent to capture Blood is the Marquis de Riconete (George Macready), a brutal man willing to do whatever it takes to bring in the wanted swashbuckler. After Riconete finally catches Blood's crew on an island, Blood must go incognito to rescue his men, all with the help of Riconete's niece Isabelita (Patricia Medina).

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Wizard of Oz
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When a tornado rips through Kansas, Dorothy and her dog, Toto, are whisked away in their house to the magical land of Oz. They follow the Yellow Brick Road toward the Emerald City to meet the Wizard, and en route they meet a Scarecrow that needs a brain, a Tin Man missing a heart, and a Cowardly Lion who wants courage. The wizard asks the group to bring him the broom of the Wicked Witch of the West to earn his help.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Planet of the Apes
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Complex sociological themes run through this science-fiction classic about three astronauts marooned on a futuristic planet where apes rule and humans are slaves. The stunned trio discovers that these highly intellectual simians can both walk upright and talk. They have even established a class system and a political structure. The astronauts suddenly find themselves part of a devalued species, trapped and imprisoned by the apes.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Monkey Business
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Chemist Dr. Barnaby Fulton (Cary Grant) is developing a pill that will defy the aging process for the pharmaceutical company run by Oliver Oxley (Charles Coburn). When a loose chimpanzee mixes chemicals together that produce this effect, Fulton tries some on himself. This prompts him to act like a teenager, making passes at Oxley's buxom secretary, Lois (Marilyn Monroe). Soon everyone, including Fulton's wife, Edwina (Ginger Rogers), is feeling the effects of the formula, with hilarious results.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Bedtime for Bonzo
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A professor (Ronald Reagan) hires a nanny (Diana Lynn) to help him raise a chimp, hoping to decide nature vs. nurture.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Every Which Way But Loose
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A tough trucker with a cheeky pet orangutan, Philo Beddoe (Clint Eastwood) moonlights as a fighter, with his close friend Orville Boggs (Geoffrey Lewis) setting up matches for him. When Philo begins dating country singer Lynn Halsey-Taylor (Sondra Locke), and she abruptly disappears, he goes off in search of her, his simian companion and Orville in tow. On their cross-country trek, Philo and friends repeatedly clash with bikers, leading up to a violent showdown.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: MGM Parade Show
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Royal Wedding
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: American sibling song-and-dance team Tom (Fred Astaire) and Ellen Bowen (Jane Powell) are in London in 1947, when all of England is in a tizzy over the impending nuptials of Princess Elizabeth and Prince Philip. Ellen falls head over heels for the dashing Lord John Brindale (Peter Lawford), and Tom becomes equally smitten with the elegant Anne Ashmond (Sarah Churchill). The film features one of Astaire's most legendary dance performances, dancing across the ceiling of a hotel room.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Singin' in the Rain
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A spoof of the turmoil that afflicted the movie industry in the late 1920s when movies went from silent to sound. When two silent movie stars', Don Lockwood and Lina Lamont, latest movie is made into a musical a chorus girl is brought in to dub Lina's speaking and singing. Don is on top of the world until Lina finds out.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Brigadoon
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Tommy Albright (Gene Kelly) and Jeff Douglas (Van Johnson), two American pals on a Scottish hunting trip, get lost in the woods and come upon the magical village of Brigadoon. Rising out of the Scottish mist only once every 100 years, and only for one day, Brigadoon is an enchanted place where life is simpler and easier, untouched by the worries of the modern world. When Tommy falls for beautiful villager Fiona Campbell (Cyd Charisse), he must decide whether to stay or to return to his life.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Annie Get Your Gun
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The musical tale of Annie Oakley (Betty Hutton) moves from stage to screen in this rollicking film adaptation. Renowned in the Wild West as a sharpshooter, Annie meets her match, both romantically and professionally, in the form of fellow ace gunslinger Frank Butler (Howard Keel). While Annie and Frank are performing as part of the famous traveling show headlined by the legendary Buffalo Bill (Louis Calhern), the two compete and flirt, with plenty of ups and downs along the way. (movie) - 1950

tvone.us.title: black-ish - Charity Case

tvone.us.description: Dre is diagnosed with Type 2 diabetes and resolves to cure himself; Jack is convinced that baby Devante hates him and enlists Junior and Diane for help.

tvone.us.title: black-ish - Inheritance
tvone.us.description: Ruby has a talk with Dre and Rhonda about her inheritance; Bow's sister hires Junior to become her assistant.

tvone.us.title: black-ish - Unkept Woman
tvone.us.description: Dre and Bow's morning routine with the kids changes; Junior bonds with Diane now that he is in charge of driving his siblings to school.

tvone.us.title: The Cosby Show - Halloween
tvone.us.description: Vanessa gets a chance to talk to the cutest boy at school at her first Halloween party.

tvone.us.description: Cliff gives Denise some pointers as she prepares to buy her first car.

tvone.us.title: The Cosby Show - Rudy Suits Up
tvone.us.description: Rudy becomes the star of a youth football team, but Cliff is worried about safety.

tvone.us.title: The Cosby Show - Clair's Sister
tvone.us.description: Clair's sister becomes engaged; Cliff struggles to beat his father-in-law (Joe Williams) at chess.

tvone.us.title: The Cosby Show - Denise's Friend
tvone.us.description: Denise's friend seeks medical advice from Cliff about a problem she is keeping from her parents.

tvone.us.title: The Cosby Show - Clair's Toe
tvone.us.description: Clair is determined not to let a broken toe interfere with her personal or professional life.

tvone.us.title: The Cosby Show - Mrs. Westlake
tvone.us.description: Cliff invites Theo's prim math teacher (Sonia Braga) to dinner.

tvone.us.title: The Cosby Show - Vanessa's Bad Grade
tvone.us.description: Vanessa tries to hide her bad report card from her parents; she and Denise fight over a sweater.

tvone.us.title: The Cosby Show - The Auction
tvone.us.description: Clair is determined to buy a valuable painting done by her great uncle at an auction.

tvone.us.title: The Cosby Show - Theo and Cockroach
tvone.us.description: Theo and his friend Cockroach are ill-prepared for an upcoming test on "Macbeth."

tvone.us.title: The Cosby Show - The Dentist
tvone.us.description: Rudy helps a friend overcome his fear of the dentist (Danny Kaye).

tvone.us.title: The Cosby Show - Play It Again, Russell
tvone.us.description: Cliff's ex-musician dad (Earle Hyman) plans to come out of retirement to play trombone at a jam session in memory of an old friend; Rudy tells knock-knock jokes.

tvone.us.title: A Different World - Honeymoon in L.A. Part 1
tvone.us.description: Whitley and Dwayne tell new students about their honeymoon in Los Angeles.

tvone.us.title: A Different World - Honeymoon in L.A. Part 2
tvone.us.description: Whitney and Dwayne search for each other after being separated during their honeymoon in Los Angeles.

tvone.us.title: A Different World - Interior Desecration or Sofa, So Good
tvone.us.description: Whitley and Dwayne try to combine their possessions in the new apartment.

tvone.us.title: A Different World - Somebody Say Ho!
tvone.us.description: Freddie puts her law school studies to good use when Terrell is brought up on charges of verbal abuse.

waypointtv.us.title: The WoodHaven Way
waypointtv.us.description: The WoodHaven Way - A Deer Camp Tradition For Mike Pentecost and his son Jacob, Illinois deer camp has become a tradition they look forward to every single year. It's a place filled with memories, time spent together, and a shared love for chasing whitetails.

waypointtv.us.title: Wildbound by Forloh
waypointtv.us.description: Wildbound -- UK Part 1 Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the venison that Michelin star chef Mark Robinson has to offer.

waypointtv.us.title: 200 : Red Moon Giants
waypointtv.us.description: These hunters know the key to taking giant whitetails consistently is all about being in the right place at the right time. Brady Snyder hunts down a giant 200 buck in Iowa from 2023.

waypointtv.us.title: HuntStand Presents : The Maestro
waypointtv.us.description: For decades, Paul Butski has set the standard in turkey calling; his name is etched into the NWTF Grand National Calling Championships Hall of Fame, and his influence stretches far beyond the stage.

waypointtv.us.title: 200 : MoonStruck
waypointtv.us.description: If you hunt big whitetails, this is a must-see!

waypointtv.us.title: The Bearded Buck : Home, Sweet Home
waypointtv.us.description: After starting turkey season off on the road, it's time for us to come back home to Pennsylvania and hunt some turkeys on our home turf! Joining us this week are our good friends from The Grind Outdoors who come in to hunt some long beards with us.

waypointtv.us.title: The Raven Project : Tagged Out at the Dirty Bird
waypointtv.us.description: The story of a true old school deer camp meeting new world management practices to take a raw piece of hunting land and develop it into whitetail Mecca.

waypointtv.us.title: Just Shot: Realtree Road Trips : Hunt for Dash
waypointtv.us.description: After taking two great bucks in Nebraska, the "Road Trips" crew came back home to Georgia with Tyler and Rigsby taking bucks on back-to-back sits; Dash makes three Georgia bucks in three sits!

waypointtv.us.title: Winchester Life : The Spies Tradition
waypointtv.us.description: Join Benny Spies of Team Winchester as he shares stories of his upbringing in South Dakota. From cherished family photos to duck seasons of the past, learn how a passion for hunting was ignited and became a way of life for Benny and his family.

waypointtv.us.title: Deer and Deer Hunting : Big Buck Secrets
waypointtv.us.description: Dan Schmidt sits down with Adam Hays to discuss the key strategies he uses to tag trophy-class whitetails year after year, from the U.S. to Canada.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Bucks for the Brave
waypointtv.us.description: Joining Denny McMahan at the Thumbtack Ranch in South Texas; after dedicating his life to service in the U.S. Army and law enforcement, he now continues the mission by teaching at the police academy; Denny is a hero in his community.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Father and Son Hunt
waypointtv.us.description: We follow along with the crew from Struttinbuck on their annual Father Son hunt at FE Hill. No matter what happens throughout the year this is always a must-have trip and a time to settle down and enjoy the great outdoors.

waypointtv.us.title: Wildbound by Forloh
waypointtv.us.description: New Zealand Andy and his son, Logan, visit the country of New Zealand; they explore vineyards, helicopter hunts and more.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Summer Farm Work, Deer Season is Coming!!
waypointtv.us.description: On this episode of Hunting Land Man Season 3, Slade puts in some early summer farm work to ensure his target bucks are well-fed!

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : The Plan for POPE!
waypointtv.us.description: On this episode of Hunting Land Man, Slade does more summer food plot prep in hopes Pope will make an appearance! With Rain on the way Slade is able to disk and seed his Pope Summer spot!

waypointtv.us.title: Ship Shape TV
waypointtv.us.description: Refit on a Surplus Console The team is taking the marine surplus console for the Aqua sport project and giving it a much-needed face lift; they meet the team at Boat Outfitters to find an acrylic covering board to fit the console and cover the pre-existing holes.

waypointtv.us.title: Ship Shape TV
waypointtv.us.description: Accessorizing the AquaSport Tips for making improvements and repairs on boats and boat equipment.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Home Grown

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Gun Down Missouri

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Selfie
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E19 Slade takes it back to the beginning.

waypointtv.us.description: S01 E03 Lifelong cowboy and Oklahoma native Bill Parker is believed to be the first man to reach the shores of Normandy on D-Day, June 6th 1944.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Mike Brennan

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Paul Wharton

waypointtv.us.description: S01 E06 After surviving the Iranian ballistic missiles hitting Iraq's Al Asad air base, Aaron Futrell recounts his memories of that horrible night.

wccodt.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wccodt.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates.

eden.uk.plus1.description: Stopping at Dundee, Michael heads for Glamis Castle, where Lady Elizabeth Bowes-Lyon, the Queen Mother grew up. Michael hears about her happy childhood and how she later found sanctuary there, when King Edward VIII abdicated and she and Prince Albert unexpectedly became King and Queen of the United Kingdom. Striking north along the east coast of Scotland Michael's next stop is Montrose from where he makes an excursion into the Eastern Highlands. (Documentary, Travel) - 2020

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Elgin to Loch Ness
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo is in the Scottish Highlands on the last leg of his rail journey through 1930s Britain. He begins in Elgin's port, the coastal town of Lossiemouth, where James Ramsay MacDonald, the Labour Party's first Prime Minister was born. Michael meets his granddaughter to visit the family home and discovers what shaped his politics. On the outskirts of Lossiemouth, Michael finds a remote boarding school established in the 1930s. (Documentary, Travel) - 2020

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - St Ives to St Day
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo boards the Great Western Railway at the Cornish seaside resort of St Ives. He discovers a Cornish fisherman, who,although he began painting only in his seventies, inspired established artists from the capital. (Documentary, Travel) - 2020

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Truro to St Mawgan
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo is in Cornwall's county town, Truro, with his 1930s Bradshaw's Guide. In the surrounding countryside, he finds the historic estate of Trewithen, whose gardens were stocked from China by professional plant hunters commissioned by its owner. The Atlantic Coast branch line carries Michael north to Newquay. (Documentary, Travel) - 2020

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Bodmin to Totnes
eden.uk.plus1.description: Clutching his 1930s Bradshaw's Guide, Michael Portillo reaches Bodmin en route to Totnes as he explores the West Country from St Ives to Salisbury Plain. Out on the rugged moor, Michael hears how the celebrated author, Daphne du Maurier, captivated readers between the wars with her tales of smuggling at the Jamaica Inn. (Documentary, Travel) - 2020

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Paignton to Tiverton
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo's exploration of the West Country continues in south Devon. Guided by his 1930s Bradshaw's, Michael arrives in Paignton to investigate an extraordinarily high murder rate in the literature of the 1930s. The Dartmouth Steam Railway conveys him in style to the beautiful home of Agatha Christie, in the company of her great-grandson, James Prichard. (Documentary, Travel) - 2020

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Taunton to Salisbury Plain
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo crosses the county line from Devon into Somerset on his rail exploration of the West Country steered by his 1930s Bradshaw's guide. (Documentary, Travel) - 2020
